Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Position Type

Permanent

Closing Date

2026-08-06

Medavie Health Services is a national leader in primary health care solutions and the largest contracted provider of emergency management services in Canada. Together with Medavie Blue Cross, we are part of Medavie, a health solutions partner committed to improving the wellbeing of Canadians.

With a growing network of 5,400 health care professionals in six provinces, Medavie Health Services has a long history of operating ground and air ambulance services, medical communications, Mobile Integrated Health/Community Paramedicine programs, 911 Public Safety, 811 Telehealth, home health care, as well as clinical training.

We are proud to invest in communities to help address some of Canada’s most pressing physical and mental health care challenges.

As an employee of Medavie Health Services, we are accountable to our patients and coworkers by participating in and supporting all safety related initiatives, as well as acting in a manner that fosters a culture that focuses on patient safety and a safe and respectful workplace.

Island EMS, a subsidiary of Medavie Health Services (MHS), began operating the ground ambulance service in Prince Edward Island in April 2006 and is responsible for the optimal operation and management of an integrated, service-led primary health care organization including Medacom Atlantic and the PEI Mobile Mental Health Program. People are the biggest drivers of our success, and we are excited to continue building a healthier Prince Edward Island together.

In this role, the Senior Data Analyst is responsible for providing contract reporting, strategic analysis and supporting key processes within Island EMS. The Senior data analyst will report to the Regional Director, Prince Edward Island Operations and will work closely with many areas of the organization, including the Island EMS leadership team, to understand their monitoring, reporting and data needs.

The incumbent will assume responsibility for the production, maintenance and support of a suite of dashboards and reports for the entire organization. They will be a subject matter expert on source system data and will accurately extract and analyze data to meet the various demands of the business. The incumbent will be a key member of a team of professionals who support the ongoing development of Key Performance indicators and monitoring and reporting of EMS system performance.

The position entails, but is not limited to the following:


Development and maintenance of dashboards as specified by the business areas.
Work closely with the other members of the team to ensure reporting standards are maintained and overall information governance is adhered to.
Act as a key advisor to the senior management team on operational and strategic data analysis
Provide data for scheduled and unscheduled reporting on contractually identified KPIs and performance measures, including reviewing all component reports for accuracy and completeness;
Prioritize incoming requests, manage expectations and working relationships.
Data mining, analysis and interpretation of data, reports and trends in EMS;
Support the ongoing development of reporting tools to reflect evolving business requirement;
Support business development through analysis of data and modelling of system impacts;
Developing evidence informed auditing tools and processes for new and existing programs, services and initiatives;
Ensure that privacy is respected in measurement and reporting systems;
Build and maintain productive working relationship with our business partners;
Other duties as assigned.


As The Ideal Candidate For This Role, You


Have a university degree, preferably a Master's degree, in Health System Performance, Health Services Research, Applied Statistics, Data Science, Systems Engineering, Health Informatics, Public Health, Epidemiology, or a related discipline; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Minimum 5 years' experience in health system analytics, performance measurement, quality improvement, decision support, or strategic planning.
Demonstrated experience developing performance frameworks, outcome measures, dashboards, and executive reporting.
Experience with data visualization technologies and business intelligence platforms.
Experience applying data to support continuous quality improvement, patient safety, accreditation, and organizational strategy.
Previous work experience or knowledge of emergency medical services is an asset
Ability to analyze, understand and interpret business requirements
Understand data-visualization concepts
Strong understanding of business drivers and KPIs (key performance indicators)
Excellent analytical, research and problem-solving skills;
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate clearly
Have comprehensive knowledge of technical database management and reporting management functions;
Have knowledge and understanding of the key records management and information management standards and legislation and information standards;


Regular business hours required, but some irregular hours can be expected.

Salary range for this position is $75,000 - $90,000 annually.

The Base Pay range may vary depending on the successful candidate or other relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and education/training. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Medavie employees may participate in various performance-based incentive programs. Payments under these programs are discretionary and subject to both individual and organizational results.

While Medavie may use automated tools, including AI, to support application screening, candidates are expected to complete all recruitment interactions independently—without AI assistance—to ensure a fair and equitable process.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Medavie Health Services is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

Title: Data Innovation & Development Specialist- EN
Description:
Description

We are IAMGOLD. Innovative, Accountable Mining.

IAMGOLD is a Canadian-based gold mining company with operations and development projects across North America and West Africa. With flagship operations such as the Côté Gold Mine in Ontario—one of Canada’s largest and most technologically advanced gold mines—we’re not just mining gold; we’re shaping the future of mining.

We believe mining can be different. By combining innovation with a strong commitment to sustainability and accountability, we create lasting value for our people and the communities where we operate. At IAMGOLD, when we engage, empower, and support each other, we create extraordinary outcomes—delivering value for our people, partners, and stakeholders while building stronger, more resilient communities.

At Côté Gold, we’re leading the way in modern mining. With an 18+ year mine life, Côté Gold will inject C$5 billion in wages into the economy and create lasting benefits for the region. Over 600 full-time jobs and strong partnerships with Mattagami and Flying Post First Nations mean you’ll be part of something bigger—building prosperity and progress for generations. Industry leaders call us “a model for modern mining and sustainability”, and you can help write the next chapter.

Want to Learn More About IAMGOLD?


Check out the IAMGOLD Blog
Read about our Côté Gold


About The Role

We are currently seeking a Data Innovation & Development Specialist to support the mine and mill’s operational data and reporting ecosystem—maintaining reliable datasets and dashboards (PI Vision, Power BI) and deliver practical analytics and automation within site governance. This role focuses on data and reporting software (not PI tag/asset configuration).

This role is based at the Côté Gold Mine Site reporting to the IT OT Superintendent.

Responsibilities:


Sustain mill reporting data layers and dashboards to deliver trusted, timely operational insights.
Maintain reporting databases and data access layers (e.g., SQL, PI) that feed standard KPI reporting.
Develop and support queries, views, procedures, and refresh schedules to ensure consistent, performant datasets.
Troubleshoot and reconcile data quality issues end-to-end with IT/OT and site SMEs.
Maintain and enhance PI Vision and Power BI dashboards (visuals, measures, filters, access) and support user adoption.
Apply governance practices for reporting services, including testing, release/rollback, KPI definitions, data dictionaries, and audit-ready lineage.
Monitor and respond to data/report outages, manage access in line with cybersecurity/data classification, and coordinate fixes with vendors as required.
Build and support small, governed analytics and automation in Microsoft Fabric (dataflows/pipelines/notebooks), including light production support and controlled changes for mining system reporting integrations.


Job Qualifications

Key Skills & Knowledge


Post-secondary degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
Post-graduate qualification or certifications in data platforms, database administration, business intelligence, or reporting tools is desirable.
Relevant vendor or industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft data/BI, SQL, AVEVA PI/PI Vision) and participation in technical communities are considered an asset.


Relevant Experience


At least 3 years of experience in a similar role.
Experience supporting operational data systems in an industrial environment (e.g., processing plant/mill), including reporting databases, historian data access, and front-end dashboards/reports (PI Vision, Power BI, or similar).
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts (e.g., query optimization, views, stored procedures) and experience delivering reliable datasets and semantic models for analytics and reporting.
Experience with modern analytics platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) and related development patterns (data pipelines/dataflows, notebooks, lakehouse/warehouse concepts) is an asset.


Skills & Strengths, We Value


Strong data analysis and troubleshooting capability, including validating, reconciling, and clearly explaining operational KPIs and data flows from OT systems through to reporting.
Experience developing and supporting dashboards and reporting solutions (e.g., PI Vision, Power BI), with an understanding of data models, refresh behaviour, and end-user needs.
Knowledge of analytics, automation, and Microsoft Fabric concepts, with an interest in applying governed solutions (e.g., dataflows, pipelines, low-code workflows, or AI use cases).
Solid understanding of governance and change control practices for reporting solutions, including testing, deployment, documentation, data privacy, and cross-functional collaboration to drive adoption.


What We Offer

At IAMGOLD, we don’t just reward performance we invest in your potential. Our total rewards package is designed to support your well-being today and encourage your growth for tomorrow. Because the future of mining, and your career, starts here.


Comprehensive Health Coverage – Extended health, dental, and insurance benefits for peace of mind.
Flexible Spending Power – Health & Personal Spending Accounts to fit your evolving needs.
Support When It Matters – Employee & Family Assistance Program for life’s challenges.
Future-Ready Savings – Registered Pension Plan with company match, plus TFSA & RRSP options.
Shared Success – Employee Share Purchase Plan with company match—because we grow together.


Salary Range: $89,000-$133,500 + bonus

The final offer is determined based on your individual skills, qualifications, and competencies and aligned with our commitment to internal equity.

We recognize that not everyone will meet every requirement listed, and that’s okay. If this role excites you and you believe you have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. We value potential and are committed to supporting growth and development.

We’re an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a workplace where every perspective sparks progress. We welcome applications from women, Indigenous Peoples, visible minorities, persons with disabilities, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community. Need accommodation during the recruitment process? Just let us know, we’ll make it happen.

Mining. Redefined. We’re building a modern mining company driven by innovation, accountability, and a deep commitment to sustainability.

Please note that IAMGOLD does not use AI tools within our applicant tracking system to support the screening of applications

bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, statistics, operations research, economics, or mathematics;

minimum eight years of applicable work experience;
strong knowledge of data visualization best practices and techniques;
experience with data curation, report creation, key performance indicator (KPI) development and statistical analysis;
analytical skills, including strong SQL query knowledge; and
self starter and ability to understand business need and execute work independently.


Recommended


experience working with an enterprise data warehouse – BigQuery, Azure or equivalent;
experience with business reporting tools – Power BI, Looker, Tableau, SSRS or equivalent;
experience with ETL tools (Dataform, Apache Airflow, SSIS, or others);
experience working with SAP technologies – S/4 HANA, CDS views, SAP Analytics Cloud; and
exposure to predictive analytics, Python, SAS or equivalent.

background check.

competitive compensation program with base and variable pay;

career development opportunities; and
relocation costs.

Title: Analyst, BI & Data
Description:
Our culture lifts you up—there is no ego in the way. Our common purpose? We all want to win for our customers. We aim to always be evolving, dynamic, and ambitious. We believe in the power of genuine connections. Each employee is a part of what makes us unique on the market: agile and dedicated.

Time Type


Regular

Job Description


Role Overview

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence & Analytics team, you will bridge the gap between complex telecom data and strategic execution. Embedded in an agile environment, you will work across our core domains (Executive Metrics & Revenue, Sales & Marketing, or Operations) to support our growing base of 1.5M+ customers across Canada and the US.

Your mandate goes beyond traditional reporting. You will not only empower internal stakeholders with robust dashboards and deep-dive analyses but also pioneer the next generation of self-service analytics by developing and integrating Agentic AI tools (e.g., AI data assistants, automated insight agents) into our data ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities



Advanced Analytics & Solution Delivery
Translate Data into Value: Act as a trusted data advisor to internal squads, answering complex business questions regarding subscriber growth, churn, revenue assurance, and operational efficiency.
Modern Deliverables: Support internal customers by delivering outcomes through four primary channels:
Reports & Decks: High-impact, strategic deep-dives and executive summaries.
Interactive Tools: Traditional, robust dashboards that monitor health and performance.
Governed Self-Service Data: Design and provision certified, highly optimized, and well-documented datasets. This enables data-savvy power users across marketing and operations to safely build their own ad-hoc analyses without risking data integrity.
Agentic AI Solutions: Innovative AI-driven assistants or automated workflows that allow stakeholders to converse with data and fetch immediate insights.
Telecom Insights: Analyze heavy data workloads related to ARPU (Average Revenue Per User), CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), LTV, network utilization, and cross-border market dynamics (Quebec/Ontario vs. US).
AI & Data Product Innovation
Agentic AI Integration: Design, test, and deploy AI agents and LLM-powered tools that interface with our data layer to automate routine queries and democratize data access.
Modern BI Modeling: Build and optimize scalable data models specifically structured to feed both visual dashboards (Tableau) and AI/LLM interfaces.
Technical Execution & Agile Collaboration
Cloud Data Warehousing: Write complex, highly optimized SQL queries in Google BigQuery to extract, transform, and analyze massive telecom datasets.
Data Visualization: Design and maintain intuitive, high-performance dashboards in Tableau.
Agile Methodology: Actively participate in cross-functional marketing or operational squads (sprints, stand-ups, grooming) under the guidance of BI Chapter Leads.


Qualifications & Skills


Technical Toolkit


SQL Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Google BigQuery (or similar cloud data warehouses) handling massive data volumes.
Data Visualization: Strong portfolio of building actionable dashboards in Tableau.
AI & Automation (The Frontier): Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM APIs, or framework development (e.g., LangChain, custom AI agents) to build data-querying bots. Python skills are a major asset.
Data Modeling: Solid understanding of star schemas, data warehousing concepts, and preparing data for consumption by both humans and AI models.


Experience & Soft Skills



Experience: 3–5+ years in a Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Product role. Experience in Telecom or subscription-based industries is highly preferred.
Agile Mindset: Proven experience working inside agile squads and managing a backlog of analytical requests.
Consultative Approach: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical data jargon into clear business recommendations for North American stakeholders.
Language: Bilingualism (English and French) is a strong asset due to our market presence in Quebec, Ontario and USA.


What We Offer



The opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven analytics in the telecom sector.
A collaborative, mature agile environment with clear mentorship from dedicated Chapter Leads.
A modern tech stack (BigQuery, Tableau, GenAI tools) with the scale of 1.5 million customers to analyze.

Our true strength? The people who bring our projects to life and keep them running.

Position Title: Systems Performance Analyst

Department: Operations & Maintenance

Location: Hybrid – Kitchener, Ontario




Position Summary

Recurrent Energy Power Services (REPS) Operations and Maintenance operates utility-scale solar plants and battery energy storage systems on five continents. With close to 5 GW contracted and under operations, REPS has developed recognized expertise in the field of solar plants and battery system operations. Engineering know-how, analytic prowess, and technical on-site skills, ensure that our clients can count on the best service for their plants.




In line with our current growth, Recurrent Energy is looking for a system performance analyst to assist in the in-depth analysis of performance data from solar photovoltaic and battery storage plants. This position is at the crossroads of solar energy, engineering, and data analytics.




Responsibilities

Analyze the performance of utility-scale solar plants and battery energy storage systems; identify trends, anomalies, and areas of improvement to optimize the plants overall performance.
Develop key performance indicators (KPIs) and reports. Present the findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including tech team and clients.
Contribute to the maintenance and development of scripts to collect and archive data, calculate plant and inverter availability, and other KPIs.
Recommend and implement performance improvements and optimization strategies to enhance energy generation and system efficiency.
Recommend and implement performance improvements and optimization strategies to enhance energy generation and system efficiency.
Develop automated diagnostic tools to analyze data and flag underperforming assets.
Develop and update performance models to simulate the expected energy output of solar systems based on design parameters, environmental conditions, and equipment specifications. Use these models to compare actual performance and identify areas for improvement.
Conduct the onboarding of new projects, from gathering plant information to full integration in our monitoring platform.
Lead and mentor junior members of the team.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, such as program managers, electrical engineers, and maintenance technicians. Provide technical support and guidance the operation phase to ensure optimal performance.
Ensure that all business activities are performed with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with the Canadian Solar Solution Code of Business Conduct.
Adhere to all environmental, health and safety rules and company policies
Complete other duties and projects as assigned.




Required Qualification and Experience

Degree in Engineering (electrical preferred) or equivalent
Familiarity with solar photovoltaic or other renewable energy systems
2+ years of experience in a similar position
Extensive knowledge of Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel)
Strong computer skills and In-depth familiarity with Python/Pandas
Knowledge of SQL, Git, BI tools an asset
Excellent communication skills and an ability to write clear, concise reports
Strong work ethic, positive team attitude and able to work in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Title: Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
About Float

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

Our Product

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 7,500 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

About The Role

Float runs on data — and this role exists to make sure the business can see itself clearly.

As our Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, you'll be the connective tissue between our data infrastructure and the decisions that leadership, Finance, RevOps, and GTM teams make every day. This isn't a support queue role — it's a strategic BI function. You'll own our reporting layer: designing, building, and governing the dashboards, metrics, and self-serve tools that let Float's teams move faster and with more confidence.

You'll sit on the data team and work in close partnership with our Analytics Engineer, translating business questions into durable data products — not one-off answers. Where the analytics engineer builds the models and the pipelines, you build the intelligence layer on top: the dashboards, the metrics definitions, the reporting cadences, and the frameworks that turn clean data into business clarity.

You're also someone who is curious and treats AI as a genuine part of how you work — using it to move faster, build more, and stretch the bounds of what a data team can actually do.

You'll report to the Head of Data and partner closely with Finance, RevOps, GTM, Sales, and the Chief of Staff.

What You'll Be Doing


Design, build, and maintain Float's core dashboards and reporting infrastructure — audit for quality, assign ownership, archive stale content, and set the standard for what good looks like
Work closely with the Analytics Engineer to translate business requirements into data models — write clear specs, validate outputs, and drive metric definition alignment across stakeholders before anything gets built
Use AI as a force multiplier — not just for drafting SQL, but for building self-serve tooling, scaling analysis and making BI more accessible to non-technical stakeholders. You bring the business context that makes AI outputs actually useful, and you know where the guardrails need to go.
Define and maintain Float's authoritative metrics library — what they measure, how they're calculated, and who owns them; surface and resolve discrepancies when Finance and RevOps aren't working from the same number
Partner with the Chief of Staff and Head of Data on QBRs, board prep, and performance reporting; turn leadership questions into clean analysis, and run exploratory deep dives to answer specific questions
Build a self-serve BI environment that reduces dependence on the data team — verified dashboards, documented metrics, and Metabase collections that Finance, Ops, Support, and Sales can navigate without filing a ticket
Flag data model gaps and quality issues to the analytics engineer; help prioritize infrastructure work based on business impact


What Success Looks Like


Land and Stabilize: BI and metric governance has a clear DRI — existing dashboards have been audited for accuracy and relevance, every key metric and report has a named owner, and outdated content has been archived.
Build the Infrastructure: The BI environment is structured and trustworthy — dashboards are verified, collections are logically organized, and AI has been used to build or scale something the team couldn't have done with headcount alone.
Enable the Flywheel: Self-serve is meaningfully better and ad-hoc request volume reflects it. Leadership is making faster decisions because they have someone who understands both the data and the business context.


What We're Looking For


2–4+ years of experience as a BI or business analyst, ideally at a high-growth fintech or SaaS company
Strong SQL — CTEs, window functions, aggregations; you write clean queries and can explain them to a non-technical stakeholder
Deep experience in a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Sigma) — you've owned a BI environment.
Comfortable reading dbt models and understanding data lineage; prior dbt experience is not necessary but ability to contribute to dbt project is expected
Comfortable using AI tools as an accelerator — LLMs for SQL drafting, documentation, or structuring analysis; you know where they're useful and where they need guardrails
Structured thinker who turns ambiguous questions into clear analytical frames — and doesn't wait to be handed one. You spot what's worth investigating and drive it yourself.
Strong written communication — your analysis only lands if the narrative does
Proactive and collaborative — you share context before being asked and work with the analytics engineer, not around them
Genuinely curious about the business, not just the data
Experience supporting a senior audiences is a strong plus
Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse is a plus
Python experience is a plus, particularly for automation or analysis outside of SQL


Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

Why You Should Join


Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies
Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters


In Short

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

About Float

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

Our Product

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 7,500 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

About The Role

Float runs on data — and this role exists to make sure the business can see itself clearly.

As our Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, you'll be the connective tissue between our data infrastructure and the decisions that leadership, Finance, RevOps, and GTM teams make every day. This isn't a support queue role — it's a strategic BI function. You'll own our reporting layer: designing, building, and governing the dashboards, metrics, and self-serve tools that let Float's teams move faster and with more confidence.

You'll sit on the data team and work in close partnership with our Analytics Engineer, translating business questions into durable data products — not one-off answers. Where the analytics engineer builds the models and the pipelines, you build the intelligence layer on top: the dashboards, the metrics definitions, the reporting cadences, and the frameworks that turn clean data into business clarity.

You're also someone who is curious and treats AI as a genuine part of how you work — using it to move faster, build more, and stretch the bounds of what a data team can actually do.

You'll report to the Head of Data and partner closely with Finance, RevOps, GTM, Sales, and the Chief of Staff.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain Float's core dashboards and reporting infrastructure — audit for quality, assign ownership, archive stale content, and set the standard for what good looks like
  • Work closely with the Analytics Engineer to translate business requirements into data models — write clear specs, validate outputs, and drive metric definition alignment across stakeholders before anything gets built
  • Use AI as a force multiplier — not just for drafting SQL, but for building self-serve tooling, scaling analysis and making BI more accessible to non-technical stakeholders. You bring the business context that makes AI outputs actually useful, and you know where the guardrails need to go.
  • Define and maintain Float's authoritative metrics library — what they measure, how they're calculated, and who owns them; surface and resolve discrepancies when Finance and RevOps aren't working from the same number
  • Partner with the Chief of Staff and Head of Data on QBRs, board prep, and performance reporting; turn leadership questions into clean analysis, and run exploratory deep dives to answer specific questions
  • Build a self-serve BI environment that reduces dependence on the data team — verified dashboards, documented metrics, and Metabase collections that Finance, Ops, Support, and Sales can navigate without filing a ticket
  • Flag data model gaps and quality issues to the analytics engineer; help prioritize infrastructure work based on business impact

What Success Looks Like

  • Land and Stabilize: BI and metric governance has a clear DRI — existing dashboards have been audited for accuracy and relevance, every key metric and report has a named owner, and outdated content has been archived.
  • Build the Infrastructure: The BI environment is structured and trustworthy — dashboards are verified, collections are logically organized, and AI has been used to build or scale something the team couldn't have done with headcount alone.
  • Enable the Flywheel: Self-serve is meaningfully better and ad-hoc request volume reflects it. Leadership is making faster decisions because they have someone who understands both the data and the business context.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–4+ years of experience as a BI or business analyst, ideally at a high-growth fintech or SaaS company
  • Strong SQL — CTEs, window functions, aggregations; you write clean queries and can explain them to a non-technical stakeholder
  • Deep experience in a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Sigma) — you've owned a BI environment.
  • Comfortable reading dbt models and understanding data lineage; prior dbt experience is not necessary but ability to contribute to dbt project is expected
  • Comfortable using AI tools as an accelerator — LLMs for SQL drafting, documentation, or structuring analysis; you know where they're useful and where they need guardrails
  • Structured thinker who turns ambiguous questions into clear analytical frames — and doesn't wait to be handed one. You spot what's worth investigating and drive it yourself.
  • Strong written communication — your analysis only lands if the narrative does
  • Proactive and collaborative — you share context before being asked and work with the analytics engineer, not around them
  • Genuinely curious about the business, not just the data
  • Experience supporting a senior audiences is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse is a plus
  • Python experience is a plus, particularly for automation or analysis outside of SQL

Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

  • Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies
  • Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
  • Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
  • Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
  • Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
  • Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and equity.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Permanent Full Time

We are seeking a highly analytical and solutions-oriented Data Analyst to support Workplace Benefits and Retirement.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and our Field Sales and Service partners. The successful candidate will possess a deep curiosity for understanding data, adept at identifying anomalies, investigating discrepancies, and the ability to design and implement efficient data-driven solutions.

In addition, the Data Analyst will build and evolve analytical reporting using Power BI, Excel, and SQL. By digging into performance results, identifying key trends, and translating complex data into clear insights, the role provides the information needed for data‑driven action to help move our business grow.

What You Will Do


Analyze, interpret, and validate large data volume to identify trends, inconsistencies, and anomalies
Provide technical and functional support on complex compensation programs, support decision-making with sound judgement backed by data, and mentor team
Write and optimize SQL queries to support data retrieval and reporting
Maintain tools and scripts using VB.NET to support business needs
Translate complex datasets into clear, compelling insights and business narratives
Work with stakeholders to improve data availability, quality, and drive automation
Ensure data accuracy and integrity through validation, reconciliation, and quality checks
Help resolve issues, perform analysis, and support application enhancements
Document data flows, models, and solutions to ensure sustainability


What You Will Bring


3+ years of hands-on experience with:
Data modeling concepts and tools
SQL (query development, optimization)
VB.NET
Power Automate
Power Apps
Power BI
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable components
Ability to model, structure, validate, and document complex datasets to support accurate and reliable decision‑making
Experience improving manual operational processes, including the ability to streamline or automate validation workflows
Proven experience identifying errors, inconsistencies, and anomalies in data
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
A proactive mindset — you seek to understand the purpose behind requests and consistently look for opportunities to improve processes and outcomes


The base salary for this position is between $54,700 - $104,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). Title: Product Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
Your Job

Flint Hills Resources is seeking a Product Analyst/Data Analyst to join our team in Wichita, KS. As an IT Product Analyst/Data Analyst, you will serve as a highly capable contributor who helps ensure strong delivery execution and continuity within the product team. You will play a critical role in translating product direction into high-quality delivery outcomes and in extending the team's impact across the broader technology ecosystem. This role is well-suited for someone ready to take accountability for delivery outcomes, influence how work gets done, and contribute meaningfully to business and technology objectives.

What You Will Do


Work closely with the business to understand problems at their root and drive solutions through technology — whether through your own development work or by collaborating across the business, software engineering, data architecture and solutions architecture.
Develop and maintain scripts, agents, and lightweight applications using tools like Python to automate processes, move data, and solve business problems.
Understand data models, system integrations, and application behavior to effectively translate business needs into sound technical approaches.
Analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and surface insights that inform product and business decisions — including understanding how application data and APIs translate into graph and analytical data models.
Own projects end-to-end — from problem statement through delivery and adoption — maintaining accountability for outcomes throughout.
Contribute to roadmap development, collaborating closely with product and business leadership to identify new features, enhancements, and incremental improvements aligned with product direction.
Continuously innovate and push the team forward — challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities to transform how work gets done, and raising the bar for those around you.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Experience in IT, data, software engineering, or a business role with demonstrated technical aptitude
A passion for or experience writing scripts, queries, or code (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, AI agents, or equivalent) to solve problems, automate processes, or move and validate data
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. This position supports institutional planning, accreditation, assessment, and compliance reporting while collaborating with academic and administrative units to strengthen the university’s strategic capacity.

Objectives

This position strengthens the university’s ability to make informed, strategic decisions. By integrating advanced analytics, Power BI dashboards, and AI driven insights, the Analyst/Statistician helps shape academic planning, improve student outcomes, and ensure accountability to internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in education, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, or a related field and 3 years related experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS, R, Python) and database tools (e.g., SQL).
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and independent work.
High level of attention to detail, clear documentation, and ability to work with sensitive information.
Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI.
Predictive modeling, time series analysis, forecasting.
Familiarity with AI assisted analytics tools (e.g., natural language query features, automated insights, predictive modeling platforms) and the curation of results.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education or institutional research, especially in the BC context.
Knowledge of student information systems (e.g., Banner).
Experience applying AI tools to data analysis, forecasting, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with accreditation standards and government reporting requirements.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Purpose of this Position:

The Enterprise Data Analyst is responsible for both designing and developing our data architecture and performing data analysis to support business decision-making. This role encompasses the end-to-end process of data collection, transformation, storage, and analysis. The Enterprise Data Analyst will work with departments across the organization to provide data solutions to our internal teams, ensuring data is reliable, accessible, and actionable, driving insights and strategic initiatives throughout the organization. They will also assist in deploying special projects for the other departments as requested.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes to support data reporting and dashboards.
Organize, model, and store raw data in our data warehouse and data lake.
Analyze and interpret data using statistical methods and tools.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Ensure the reliability, efficiency, and quality of data by developing and implementing processes for data cleaning, transformation, and validation.

Competencies:

Ability to learn internal software and systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage competing projects and priorities effectively.
Ability to interact with varying organizational levels confidently.
Ability to communicate technical information coherently to a variety of stakeholders.
Ability to confidentially interact with and interpret organizational information.
Strong analytical skills.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience:

Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, including 6+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization.
Experience with enterprise software or the transportation and logistics industry is a plus.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Working knowledge of at least one major programming language (e.g., Python, C#, Java, or Scala) required.
Proficiency with statistical analysis and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) required.
Familiarity with big data technologies and platforms such as Delta Lake, Spark, and Databricks required.
Experience with SQL and relational databases is highly preferred.
Knowledge of schema design, data modeling, and data analysis is preferred.
Familiarity with data orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect is preferred.
Preferred certifications in Azure, Power BI, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering include, but are not limited to:
Azure Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
DataCamp Data Engineer Certification
DataCamp Data Analyst Certification
DataCamp Data Scientist Certification
Other related cloud, analytics, or data engineering certifications

When you join McLeod, you’re joining a company that’s built for the long haul—with a clear vision, strong leadership, and a commitment to investing in our people.

Title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About The Role

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

About The Role


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


What You'll Do


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


Required Qualifications


3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.


Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.


Cross-Functional Impact: Your pricing work carries weight beyond the Pricing team—recommendations you make will shape decisions across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance.
AI-First Skill Building: AI is a first-class tool here, not a buzzword. You will use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily and actively shape how the team adopts them.
Real Ownership: This role pairs tactical pricing execution with strategic contributions. You will report to an experienced Sr. Pricing Analyst with growth-focused mentorship and high visibility from day one.
Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.


Interview Process


Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Sr. Pricing Analyst focused on your analytical approach, pricing experience, and AI tool proficiency.
Take-Home Assignment - A pre-built test requiring high-level analysis, the use and documentation of AI as a working partner, and advanced communication skills to convey complex business recommendations.
In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Cottonwood Heights office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.


Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for you to join our team as a Data Analyst. This position focuses on data analysis for law enforcement support, requiring a combination of investigative data expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work under high-pressure, mission-critical environments. This role will involve working with diverse data sets, ensuring accuracy and integrity while supporting ongoing criminal and civil investigations.

Our ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with law enforcement agencies. We are looking for more than just a "Data Analyst"—this role requires a technologist with excellent communication skills, customer service, and a passion for data and problem-solving.

Contributions

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis and Trend Recognition: Compile and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends across various data sets, locations, and targets.
Data Accuracy and Assessment: Monitor data for accuracy, integrity, authenticity, and relevancy. Identify intelligence gaps and assess data viability for investigative purposes.
Investigative Support: Collaborate with teams to examine data gathered from criminal and civil investigations, developing methodologies to exploit investigative information.
Quality Control & Reporting: Participate in the development of work products, conducting periodic progress reviews and ensuring quality control of findings. Regularly report findings to lead personnel.
Data Entry: Perform data entry from both hard and soft copies into large-scale data processing systems, utilizing tools like optical character readers, scanners, and digital cameras as appropriate.
Law Enforcement Support: Provide critical law enforcement support, interacting with various agencies through multiple channels of communication, while managing data under tight timelines in a high-pressure environment.
Data Visualization and Tools: Leverage MS Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to design and build formulas, charts, pivot tables, and manipulate unstructured data from different platforms.
You will be part of our Data Exploitation Practice!


Qualifications

Required:


Ability to hold a position of SECRET clearance level with the US government.
4 years of Military or law enforcement background or exposure.
Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of work experience OR 9 years of work experience and no degree.
3+ years of experience in SQL and Python
5+ years of experience using data analytic/visualization tools such as MS Excel, Power BI, or others to design charts, create formulas, and analyze unstructured data (can be job or education-based).
2+ years of experience manipulating unstructured data from different platforms; and experience in IT, statistics, computer information systems, auditing, investigative, mathematics, and units of measure
Skilled at multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear communications with stakeholders.
Must be local to El, Paso TX or willing to drive on site 5 days a week.
Applicants selected will be subject to a Government background investigation and must meet eligibility and suitability requirements.


Preferred


Law enforcement/drug data desired.
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-paced environment, including collaboration with various teams.
Strong analytical skills for identifying trends, gaps, and ensuring data accuracy and
Experience with documenting processes and developing SOPs for data handling and
Demonstrated experience in reverse engineering and validation of data processes.
Ability to communicate findings and updates effectively during briefings and team

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $50,000 to $115,000. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here.

Identity Statement

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Steampunk is a Change Agent in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our Human-Centered delivery methodology, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Data Analyst is the single point of accountability for the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of Allied Business Solutions' core business data across our ERP, CRM, and PSA platforms. This is a hands-on, technical role focused on keeping data clean, aligned, and trustworthy as it moves between systems — through disciplined data standards, active auditing, direct ownership of integrations and data synchronization, and targeted automation that eliminates manual entry and enforces quality. The Data Analyst ensures that every department works from a single, reliable source of truth, and provides reporting that turns well-governed data into usable insight for sales, service, and finance.




Key Responsibilities:




Cross-System Data Stewardship & Integrity

Serve as the single point of accountability for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the ERP, CRM, PSA, and related business systems.
Establish and enforce data standards, naming conventions, and entry rules so records remain consistent across systems and users.
Perform regular audits to identify and resolve errors, duplicates, gaps, and cross-system mismatches.
Own master and reference data (customers, products, pricing, equipment) so a single source of truth is reflected consistently everywhere it appears.
Maintain data dictionaries and documentation covering field definitions, ownership, and standards.

Data Integration & Synchronization

Own the flow and synchronization of data between the ERP, CRM, PSA, and other platforms, ensuring records stay aligned across all systems.
Write and maintain SQL queries to validate, extract, and reconcile data.
Build and maintain API-based integrations; troubleshoot sync failures and drive root-cause resolution with vendors or internal stakeholders.
Monitor integration health and proactively catch and correct data drift before it reaches downstream teams.

Automation for Data Quality & CRM Workflows

Design, build, and maintain automated routines that reduce manual entry and enforce data quality — deduplication, validation, reconciliation, and exception alerting.
Build and maintain CRM workflow automations that streamline sales and service processes and keep records current.
Document automations and adapt them as business needs evolve.

Product, Pricing & Proposal Data

Maintain accurate product records, configurations, and pricing across systems.
Keep proposal templates and pricing data current so quotes and proposals generate from clean, correct source data.

Lease & Asset Data Reconciliation

Maintain lease and asset records and reconcile them against related data across systems for consistency.
Monitor key dates — renewals, expirations, and term changes — and flag them to the appropriate stakeholders.

Reporting & Data Support

Generate routine and ad hoc reports to support the sales, service, and finance teams.
Support cross-departmental data requests and help translate data into usable insight.
Identify opportunities to improve data workflows, accuracy, and reporting efficiency.




Qualifications:




Required

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Proven experience managing data across CRM, ERP, PSA, or comparable business systems.
Hands-on SQL skills for querying, validation, and reconciliation.
Experience building and maintaining integrations (APIs) and troubleshooting data-sync issues.
Experience with process automation.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred

Familiarity with data governance and master data management practices.
Experience with data reporting and visualization/dashboarding tools.
Familiarity with lease or asset tracking systems.
Scripting for automation (e.g., Python or PowerShell) or experience with low-code automation platforms.
Background in the managed IT, technology, or copier/print industry.

Competencies

Ownership and accountability for data integrity
Problem-solving and analytical thinking
Technical aptitude and adaptability
Clear written and verbal communication
Dependability and follow-through
Collaboration across teams

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our growing Data & Analytics team at Funko. In this role, you will leverage data to deliver actionable insights that support business growth, operational efficiency, and smarter decision-making. Partner with Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and other teams to support data-driven decisions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking in BI tools (Power BI, Tableau Looker, etc.)
Develop AI-enabled and automated reporting solutions to enhance insight generation and reduce manual work
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and business recommendations
Write and optimize SQL queries to work with large, complex datasets
Identify predictive modeling opportunities and build models
Collaborate with Data Engineering to improve data models, data quality, and reporting scalability
Support reporting and analytics needs tied to ERP and operational systems
What You’ll Bring
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
Data science skill set: knowledgeable in statistical modeling (e.g. linear and logistical regression, classification, clustering) and tooling (python, R, etc.) with broad domain applicability
Experience with AI-driven analytics, automated reporting, or leveraging machine learning outputs in reporting workflows

Solid understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts

Clear communication skills with the ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders

Strong analytical skills with attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience building dashboards, using measures, and metrics.
Skillful at reading, writing and interpreting documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

Own and support monthly validation processes for print telemetry outputs, dashboard semantic layers, and related usage/share reporting handoffs

Develop and maintain automated and well-documented processes that support recurring validation, issue diagnosis, data quality checks, and stakeholder decision-making
Conduct root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across sources, grains, tables, dashboards, and processing layers, especially where definitions, filters, platform coverage, or reporting timing create mismatches
Provide consultative support for quick-turn ad hoc requests, escalation support, and deep-dive investigations while helping route work through the appropriate intake, prioritization, and transition processes
