Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.

Job Description

Why You’ll Love EECOL

When you join EECOL, you become part of a global leader in business-to-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain management solutions. We provide a compensation package that offers competitive wages, flexible hours, excellent benefits, and a career you can be proud of. Permanent, full-time positions, Monday through Friday. Weekends and evenings are for friends, family, and fun, not work!
Enjoy regular salary reviews and incentive opportunities.
EECOL is not just a job, but a company where you can learn, develop, and build your career! All training provided.

As a Pricing Analyst you will be responsible for using advanced data mining and analysis skills to maximize margins through price setting. Responsibilities


Manage pricing execution, including data integrity and consistency.
Preforms advanced analytics of margin opportunities and provides recommendations for improvement

Analyzes new and existing pricing agreements and implements updates in accordance with established pricing strategies to meet financial goals and objectives
Resolves issues related to pricing with sales and purchasing teams. Initiates any necessary adjustments and/or corrections
Collaborates with purchasing and sales leadership to execute on defined cost protections methods


Qualifications


1 year required, 2 years preferred of analytical pricing, purchasing, or finance experience
Previous experience handling confidential and sensitive data
Ability to generate accurate and timely analysis using Microsoft excel
Proficiency in Microsoft OneDrive and OneNote
Strong data mining, aggregation, analytical skills, and problem-solving capability
Ability to multitask, set priorities, deadline management, and project management skills.
Ability to interact and work with management
Ability to work independently and within a team environment
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
Detail oriented with strong work ethic
Effective organizational skills


** This is an on-site position**

About Us

The work you do and the work we do together matters. We come to work every day with a common purpose: to contribute to a well-functioning housing system.

At CMHC, we hold ourselves accountable for our results and support our colleagues in their achievements. We thrive on collaboration, connecting across CMHC and involving the right people to get our work done. Join us and be part of a team that's committed to making a real difference and be part of something meaningful.

What’s in it for you

Benefits

We’ve got the purpose, the people and the perks you need for a fulfilling career. Here’s the comprehensive and generous benefits you get when you’re a permanent employee:


Annual Paid vacation.
Annual individual performance incentive.
Defined benefit pension plan.
Comprehensive group insurance plan to support your well-being from day one.
Support towards your personal and professional growth with training, mentorship and more.
An inclusive workplace culture and environment.
While positions at CMHC require some in-office presence, alternative work arrangements may be considered for Indigenous candidates.


About The Role

Join the Data team, in the Analyst, Business Systems position. The role involves the delivery of data services and products to both internal and external clients through effective systems analysis and design, modeling, programming and data manipulation. The ideal candidate will have solid programming and analytical skills and can also understand client needs and translate this into useful data. This is a challenging and exciting role for someone who is passionate about data and wants to make a difference in the housing sector.

What You’ll Do


Support business-as-usual production of various data products and reports (includes production of static data tables in Excel, Power BI dashboards, and flat files for website applications such as the Housing Market Information Portal).
Perform programming and quantitative analysis services on research or policy issues by accessing internal and external data sources, integrating and reconciling data from alternate sources, analyzing and disseminating results in order to respond to client custom data requests.
Identify where automation could create more efficient data related processes and implementing those efficiencies in end-user systems.
Introduce new and follow existing quality assurance processes to ensure that all disseminated products contain accurate data and are of high quality.
Maintain definitions and descriptions of data produced, stored and used by Data Division; ensure good process documentation.
Assist with Data Division technology and data transformation projects: this involves migrating large data sets from legacy systems (Mainframe, SAS datasets) to Azure Databricks platform as well as modernizing and automating data ingestion, processing, quality assurance and dissemination.
Assist in transforming legacy SAS code to other programming languages and data processing frameworks, including Python and PySpark.


What You Should Have


An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline: computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, data analysis/science, engineering, or related quantitative field.
A minimum 3 years of relevant programming and quantitative analysis experience.
Advanced skills in Excel.
Intermediate to advanced programming skills in Python, including Pandas and NumPy.
Intermediate to advanced skills in SQL: ability to write complex queries, including JOINs and subqueries.
The ability to work with Apache Spark and/or PySpark.
Familiar with Azure Databricks and Azure DevOps.
Collaborative team player with strong customer service, interpersonal and written/verbal communication skills.


It Would Be Great If You Also Had


Intermediate to advanced skills in SAS (experience working with SAS statistical software suite to perform programming tasks is considered an asset).
Working knowledge of AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie) to support data analysis, code development, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Some project management experience/exposure acquired through being a subject matter expert on small to medium-sized technology projects.
A master’s degree in the above disciplines is considered an asset.

We’re committed to employment equity and encourage women, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, veterans and persons of all races, ethnicities, religions, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities and expressions to apply. We also welcome applications from non-Canadians who are eligible to work in Canada.

CMHC is an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought – and of people – are recognized, valued, and considered essential to achieving our mission.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Revenue Insights Analyst to own the development, maintenance, and evolution of reporting and analytics across Sales. This role will be the central point of contact for business intelligence, translating stakeholder needs into scalable data models, dashboards, and actionable insights.

You will play a key role in improving revenue visibility, enabling self-serve reporting, and driving data informed decision-making across the organization. Business Intelligence & Dashboarding


Design, build, and maintain intuitive Power BI dashboards across Sales
Develop scalable data models and standardized metrics to ensure consistency across reporting
Optimize performance and usability of BI assets for self-serve consumption


Stakeholder Partnership


Partner with Sales and leadership to gather business requirements
Translate needs into clear KPIs, reports, and dashboards
Act as the primary point of contact for reporting requests and enhancements


Revenue Analytics


Deliver insights on pipeline health, conversion, forecasting, and revenue trends
Support analysis such as win/loss and revenue performance drivers
Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities to improve revenue outcomes


Data & Systems Alignment


Work with CRM systems (Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics) to ensure data integrity and alignment
Structure and transform data for effective reporting and analytics
Support ongoing improvements in data quality and governance
Leverage and maintain business intelligence tools (Power BI and Tableau), ensuring consistency, performance, and alignment across reporting platforms


Reporting Operations


Manage dashboard updates, enhancements, and small change requests
Ensure reporting remains accurate, timely, and aligned with evolving business needs.

2–5+ years experience in business intelligence, analytics, or revenue operations
Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization best practices)
Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics)
Solid understanding of revenue metrics (pipeline, conversion rates, forecasting, ARR, churn)
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally
Detail-oriented with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Experience in SaaS, automotive, or data-driven industries

Engaging with program areas to gather, clarify, and document reporting and information needs.

Key Responsibilities Include:


Designing and developing standard reports and dashboards using Power BI (Business Intelligence) and related reporting tools.

Configuring data queries, calculations, and transformations using approved methodologies.
Testing and validating reports to ensure accuracy, reliability, and usability.
Supporting ongoing maintenance and enhancement of reporting products based on business needs and client feedback.
Ensuring reporting outputs meet quality standards and align with documented requirements.

Responding to service requests and inquiries related to reporting and data.

Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement

Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role

  • Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
  • Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
  • Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
  • Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
  • Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
  • Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
  • Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
  • Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
  • Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.

About You

  • You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
  • You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
  • Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
  • You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
  • You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
  • You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
  • You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
  • You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
  • You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Who We Are

Fairstone Bank and its family of brands are united in delivering innovative, accessible and reliable financial solutions that enable Canadians to reach their goals. Over the years, our brand family has grown. In 2024, Home Trust Company, Home Bank and Oaken Financial became part of the Fairstone Bank family of brands, alongside Fairstone, EdenPark and Fig.

Together, we are the leading alternative lending bank in Canada. With a diverse suite of products—residential and commercial mortgages, consumer deposits and GICs, credit cards, retail and automobile financing, personal loans and digital lending—we offer financial solutions tailored to all Canadians, including newcomers, small-business owners, smart investors and savvy consumers.

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven Product Analyst to drive product performance through rigorous experimentation, advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and scalable reporting. This role will own the design and analysis of A/B tests, develop predictive models to anticipate user behavior and outcomes, and translate insights into actionable business insights and strategy.

This is a fixed term contract for 12 months.

Key Responsibilities

Experimentation & Testing


Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across product features and user journeys
Define success metrics, guardrails, and statistical frameworks for experimentation
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Engineering, to prioritize and implement test roadmaps
Ensure test quality, validity, and scalability through best practices


Product Analytics


Analyze user behavior, funnels, cohorts, and feature adoption to identify opportunities
Translate business questions into analytical and statistical frameworks
Perform root cause analysis on product performance issues
Support product strategy with data-driven insights and recommendations


Predictive Modeling


Develop and deploy predictive models (e.g., propensity, churn, conversion, LTV) to forecast user behavior and business outcomes
Build segmentation and scoring frameworks to enable targeted product strategies
Incorporate model outputs into product decisions, experimentation, and optimization pipelines
Monitor model performance and recalibrate based on data drift and evolving user behavior


Dashboarding & Reporting


Build and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
Enable self-serve analytics through scalable data models and clear metric definitions
Automate reporting pipelines and standardize KPI tracking
Communicate insights through concise, executive-ready summaries


What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, economics, or similar fields, with a quantitative focus.
3+ years in product analytics, experimentation, or data science roles
Strong SQL and experience with Python/R for statistical analysis and modeling
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experimental design
Experience building predictive models (e.g., regression, classification, ML techniques)
Proficiency in dashboarding tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
Solid understanding of product metrics (funnels, retention, LTV, conversion)
Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable business insights
Proficiency with reporting and analytical tools such as Quick Sight, Py, SAS, SQL is a plus.
Knowledgeable in multichannel interaction and attribution models
Experience in AI is a plus
Proficient in data storytelling and presentation, including PowerPoint and other presentation tools.
Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and visual) with the ability to cultivate effective relationships across cross functional teams (business, marketing, product, technical, etc.)
Ability to work independently, multi-task and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous work environment.


What You’ll Love About Working Here


Award-Winning Culture: We’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work Canada 2025 and one of Montreal’s Top Employers 2025 by Canada’s Top 100 Employers.
Work-Life Balance: Enjoy flexibility with our hybrid work model designed to support your lifestyle.
On-Site Fitness: Gym access at our London and Montreal offices.


What You Can Expect - Pay & Process


Expected base salary: $60,000 - $75,000.
This posting is for an existing temporary vacancy within our organization.
Artificial intelligence may be used in parts of the recruitment process.
All candidates considered for hire must successfully pass a criminal background check, credit check, and validation of their work experience to qualify for hire.

Position Type

Permanent

Closing Date

2026-08-06

Medavie Health Services is a national leader in primary health care solutions and the largest contracted provider of emergency management services in Canada. Together with Medavie Blue Cross, we are part of Medavie, a health solutions partner committed to improving the wellbeing of Canadians.

With a growing network of 5,400 health care professionals in six provinces, Medavie Health Services has a long history of operating ground and air ambulance services, medical communications, Mobile Integrated Health/Community Paramedicine programs, 911 Public Safety, 811 Telehealth, home health care, as well as clinical training.

We are proud to invest in communities to help address some of Canada’s most pressing physical and mental health care challenges.

As an employee of Medavie Health Services, we are accountable to our patients and coworkers by participating in and supporting all safety related initiatives, as well as acting in a manner that fosters a culture that focuses on patient safety and a safe and respectful workplace.

Island EMS, a subsidiary of Medavie Health Services (MHS), began operating the ground ambulance service in Prince Edward Island in April 2006 and is responsible for the optimal operation and management of an integrated, service-led primary health care organization including Medacom Atlantic and the PEI Mobile Mental Health Program. People are the biggest drivers of our success, and we are excited to continue building a healthier Prince Edward Island together.

In this role, the Senior Data Analyst is responsible for providing contract reporting, strategic analysis and supporting key processes within Island EMS. The Senior data analyst will report to the Regional Director, Prince Edward Island Operations and will work closely with many areas of the organization, including the Island EMS leadership team, to understand their monitoring, reporting and data needs.

The incumbent will assume responsibility for the production, maintenance and support of a suite of dashboards and reports for the entire organization. They will be a subject matter expert on source system data and will accurately extract and analyze data to meet the various demands of the business. The incumbent will be a key member of a team of professionals who support the ongoing development of Key Performance indicators and monitoring and reporting of EMS system performance.

The position entails, but is not limited to the following:


Development and maintenance of dashboards as specified by the business areas.
Work closely with the other members of the team to ensure reporting standards are maintained and overall information governance is adhered to.
Act as a key advisor to the senior management team on operational and strategic data analysis
Provide data for scheduled and unscheduled reporting on contractually identified KPIs and performance measures, including reviewing all component reports for accuracy and completeness;
Prioritize incoming requests, manage expectations and working relationships.
Data mining, analysis and interpretation of data, reports and trends in EMS;
Support the ongoing development of reporting tools to reflect evolving business requirement;
Support business development through analysis of data and modelling of system impacts;
Developing evidence informed auditing tools and processes for new and existing programs, services and initiatives;
Ensure that privacy is respected in measurement and reporting systems;
Build and maintain productive working relationship with our business partners;
Other duties as assigned.


As The Ideal Candidate For This Role, You


Have a university degree, preferably a Master's degree, in Health System Performance, Health Services Research, Applied Statistics, Data Science, Systems Engineering, Health Informatics, Public Health, Epidemiology, or a related discipline; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Minimum 5 years' experience in health system analytics, performance measurement, quality improvement, decision support, or strategic planning.
Demonstrated experience developing performance frameworks, outcome measures, dashboards, and executive reporting.
Experience with data visualization technologies and business intelligence platforms.
Experience applying data to support continuous quality improvement, patient safety, accreditation, and organizational strategy.
Previous work experience or knowledge of emergency medical services is an asset
Ability to analyze, understand and interpret business requirements
Understand data-visualization concepts
Strong understanding of business drivers and KPIs (key performance indicators)
Excellent analytical, research and problem-solving skills;
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate clearly

Title: Finance Business Analyst
Description:
Jones Healthcare Group – Where Innovation Meets Purpose!

Why this Role Matters

The Finance Business Analyst ensures our pricing, profitability, and production decisions are grounded in accurate, trusted data.

This role transforms financial and operational data from static reports into predictive, decision-driving tools.

This role enables leaders to identify inefficiencies, manage constraints, and drive profitable growth with confidence.

As a Finance Business Analyst, you’ll play a key role in helping the Company make smarter operational and financial decisions. You’ll be responsible for the integrity of our business performance models and ERP data, ensuring pricing, profitability, and production decisions are built on accurate, trusted information. By partnering with Information & Business Technology (IBT) and Operations, you’ll help modernize our analytical capabilities through data, automation, and predictive modelling to support informed business decisions.

What You’ll Be Accountable For


Business Performance & Quoting Enablement: Design and optimize data‑driven quoting and pricing models that integrate material costs, production data, and operational constraints to improve accuracy, speed, and profitability.
Data Governance & ERP Integrity: Own the accuracy and lifecycle management of ERP master data, including Bill of Materials (BOMs), semi-finished goods (SFGs), and tooling records. Use data auditing and automation approaches to maintain reliable, decision-ready information.
Automated Performance & Variance Analysis: Develop automated performance dashboards and variance analyses that identify margin risks, pricing gaps, and cost drivers to support Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and leadership decision-making.
Strategic Modeling & Pricing Infrastructure: Build and enhance scalable, financial and production models using SQL and Power BI. Transform manual spreadsheet-based processes into more efficient, centralized solutions that support profitability analysis and business decision‑making.
Data-Led Operational & Investment Modeling: Develop predictive and scenario‑based models to evaluate capacity constraints, ROI opportunities, and capital investment decisions.
Systems Collaboration & Analytics Transformation: Act as a key contributor to FP&A’s data strategy by partnering with IBT and Operations to modernize data capabilities, improve analytical tools, and implement scalable solutions that shift analytics away from legacy, manual processes.


What You’ll Bring


Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Print Graphics Management, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Strong understanding of finance and accounting principles, including manufacturing cost accounting, costing methodologies, variance analysis, and margin drivers.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) to manage and analyze master data, pricing, and production records.
Demonstrated ability to improve processes by automating or digitizing manual workflows using data and analytics tools.
Advanced data and analytics skills, including Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, data modeling), SQL (querying relational data), and Power BI (DAX and building self-service dashboard development).
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations for business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
A systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how data flows through business processes and impacts financial outcomes.

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.

Performance Management

Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership

Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. About Us

Cameco is one of the largest global providers of the uranium fuel needed to power a secure energy future. Utilities around the world rely on our nuclear fuel products to generate safe, reliable, emissions-free nuclear power. Cameco’s corporate office is based in Saskatoon. We have mining operations and projects in northern Saskatchewan, Kazakhstan, the United States and Australia. We are also a leading supplier of uranium refining, conversion, and fuel manufacturing services from our operations in Ontario.

The Role

Cameco’s business technology services (BTS) department provides vital services to world-wide operations utilizing a variety of technologies to support key operations. We are looking for an enthusiastic, hard-working team-player to join the Business Intelligence team to administer and support the operational data needs of our Supply Chain department. This is a great opportunity to develop skills in a high demand technology, as well as to interact with the business and understand their needs to provide innovative solutions using data modelling and content development.

In This Role, You Will


Work within a team of technical experts to understand the data requirements and optimise their use within supply chain management.
Improve business processes and drive innovation using business data and analytics.
Be responsible for developing creative dashboards, front-end visualizations and data modelling that will provide decision support capabilities.
Be part of an exciting digital transformation journey, as Cameco matures from descriptive to more predictive and prescriptive data analytics.


Required


bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, statistics, operations research, economics, or mathematics;
experience with SAP in the following areas: Supply Chain, Plan to Pay, Materials Management and Finance;
minimum eight years of applicable work experience;
strong knowledge of data visualization best practices and techniques;
experience with data curation, report creation, key performance indicator (KPI) development and statistical analysis;
analytical skills, including strong SQL query knowledge; and
self starter and ability to understand business need and execute work independently.


Recommended


experience working with an enterprise data warehouse – BigQuery, Azure or equivalent;
experience with business reporting tools – Power BI, Looker, Tableau, SSRS or equivalent;
experience with ETL tools (Dataform, Apache Airflow, SSIS, or others);
experience working with SAP technologies – S/4 HANA, CDS views, SAP Analytics Cloud; and
exposure to predictive analytics, Python, SAS or equivalent.


Conditions Of Employment


background check.


Cameco is proud to offer a competitive total reward package which includes:


competitive compensation program with base and variable pay;
flexible health, drug, dental, and vision plan with a health spending and personal spending account;
fixed benefits including employee and dependant life, AD&D, disability benefits and paid vacation leave;
Employee and Family Assistance Programs;
RRSP and RPP matching program;
career development opportunities; and
relocation costs.

We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join D&I to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst – Microsoft Power Platform

Hybrid from Kraków.

Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to transform complex data into actionable business insights, automate operational processes, and develop user-friendly business applications.

The successful candidate will work extensively with the Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, while also using Excel, SQL, and Python to support data analysis, reporting, and process improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports to monitor key performance indicators and business performance.
Build and optimize data models, measures, and calculations using DAX.
Use Power Automate to streamline repetitive tasks, automate workflows, and improve operational efficiency.
Develop and maintain custom business applications using Power Apps.
Collect, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Use advanced Excel functionalities, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, and complex formulas.
Write SQL queries to extract, combine, and analyze data from databases.
Use Python, including libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, to automate data processing and support advanced analysis.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting, automation, and application requirements.
Translate business needs into practical and scalable technical solutions.
Present analytical findings and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to improve existing reporting processes, workflows, and data quality.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Previous professional experience in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Reporting Analyst, or similar role.
Strong experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, dashboard creation, and data visualisation.
Practical experience with Power Apps and Power Automate.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, Power Query, and data analysis.
Working knowledge of SQL, including writing queries, joins, filters, and data extraction.
Basic to intermediate Python knowledge for data manipulation and automation, preferably using Pandas and NumPy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into clear business recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing end-to-end reporting, automation, or business application solutions.
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to gather and define requirements.
Proactive approach to identifying process improvement and automation opportunities.
Experience working with data from multiple systems or sources.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Solving complex problems by turning vast amounts of data into business insights through advanced analytics and effectively communicating findings to a variety of stakeholders.
Framing the problem together with stakeholders, exploring large data sets, preparing data for own analysis.
Creating and maintaining documentation related to your work to ensure that stakeholders have the necessary information to understand the data & analysis of input/outputs.
Sharing knowledge in Communities of Practice, thereby enriching collective understanding and fostering a culture of continuous learning.



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​



You will be part of Tech Sustainability team in Corporate Tech Domain. You will work closely with the data analysts from all sustainability areas and the program manager and data engineer from your scope.







WHO YOU ARE​



We are looking for people with…​



Academic degree in Statistics, Engineering or related field.
Proficiency in Power BI as data visualization and reporting tool.
High proficiency in SQL.
Proven ability to independently lead data projects, maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, and design technical solutions that address complex business requirements.
Strong experience with data modelling, and different connectors for data solutions (Big Query, SharePoint).
Experience with Google Cloud environment, data quality and testing.

It is also preferred to have...



Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis, automation, and statistical modelling.
Experience working with sustainability data or CSRD legal reporting.
Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, dbt, or similar cloud-based data transformation frameworks.
Knowledge of data governance, data lineage, metadata management, and master data management practices.

And people who have…​



Experience working in agile, iterative product development environments.
A Proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the ability to manage ambiguity and adapt quickly to change.
Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.
A collaborative approach, always looking for ways to enhance the product and the team’s ways of working.

Title: Data Analyst Créditos y Cobros - Data & Finanzas
Description:
🏠🔐Movistar Prosegur Alarmas (MPA), Joint-Venture de Telefónica y Prosegur, es un referente del sector de las alarmas en España que proporciona a hogares, empresas y comercios una seguridad de confianza basada en las soluciones más avanzadas del mercado. MPA cuenta en la actualidad con una base de clientes de 600K, que se ha más que duplicado desde la creación de la JV en el 2020.

¿Y tú? ¿Te sientes identificado con nuestro propósito? ¿Te apasionan los retos y quieres llevar tu carrera profesional a otro nivel? Hoy tienes la oportunidad de hacerlo sumándote a nuestro Team of Teams de Movistar Prosegur Alarmas como Analista de Datos de Créditos y Cobros




🎯 Misión del puesto:

Buscamos una persona con sólida base financiera y experiencia en análisis de datos, que quiera formar parte de un entorno donde el análisis tiene un impacto directo en la toma de decisiones y en la optimización de la gestión de deuda.

La persona seleccionada trabajará con bases de datos de deuda pendiente de clientes, siendo responsable de transformar grandes volúmenes de información financiera en análisis estructurados, segmentaciones útiles y cuadros de mando industrializados.

El rol combina visión financiera, capacidad analítica y orientación a negocio, participando activamente en la definición de indicadores clave y en la comunicación de resultados a distintos niveles de la organización.

Es una excelente oportunidad para aprender, crecer y tener un papel protagonista en la creación y estructuración de un área de análisis y reporting.




🧩 Funciones principales

Análisis y explotación de datos financieros de deuda y facturación: tipología, movimientos mensuales, insolvencias, etc.
Definición e implementación de procedimientos de reporting recurrente para apoyar la toma de decisiones.
Seguimiento de indicadores financieros, detección de desviaciones, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.
Identificación y mejora de procesos automáticos en herramientas de gestión de deuda.
Colaboración con el equipo de BI en la creación de cuadros de mando.
Definición y evolución de KPIs financieros y de cobros.




✅ Requisitos

Grado en ADE o similar.
Valorable Máster en Análisis de Datos / Data Analytics.
Excel avanzado (Power Query) y DAX.
SQL (imprescindible).
Valorable conocimiento de Python (Pandas).
Experiencia o interés en gestión de deuda, cobros, facturación o contabilidad clientes.
Se valorará experiencia con herramientas de gestión de cobros.
Conocimiento (aunque sea básico) de ERP Cloud (Oracle), Salesforce o Siebel.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo transversal.




⭐ Se ofrece

Proyecto con impacto real en negocio.
Entorno colaborativo y orientado a datos.
Desarrollo profesional en un área estratégica.
Condiciones competitivas acorde a experiencia.
Salario fijo + variable por consecución de objetivos.

Title: Data Analyst MSBI / Power BI H/F
Description:
Qui sommes-nous ?



Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.



Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.





Description du poste



NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst MSBI / Power BI H/F, en CDI, à Lyon !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu interviens pour le compte d'un acteur du secteur bancaire, dans une équipe transverse qui conçoit et pilote les applications décisionnelles dédiées à la mesure du niveau de sécurité du SI et à l'automatisation des contrôles de conformité. Dans un contexte international à forte exigence réglementaire, tu évolues au contact d'interlocuteurs variés pour urbaniser, sécuriser et valoriser le patrimoine de données du groupe.





Tes missions :



Analyse & Cadrage : Comprendre les besoins métiers, participer aux réflexions d'architecture Data et être force de proposition pour optimiser, simplifier et sécuriser la chaîne décisionnelle.



Traitements & Modélisation : Concevoir les pipelines d'intégration (ETL) et modéliser les données sur l'environnement SQL Server / MSBI.



Restitution & Dashboards : Développer des tableaux de bord interactifs sous Power BI et concevoir des rapports paginés pour piloter les indicateurs de risques et de conformité du SI.



Automatisation : Mettre en œuvre des flux d'automatisations via Power Automate pour vérifier le respect des règles de sécurité et alerter sur les anomalies.



Suivi & Amélioration continue : Proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la qualité des données, optimiser les performances des requêtes et maintenir la documentation technique à jour.





Qualifications



De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu justifies d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans en tant que Data Analyst ou Ingénieur BI.



Tu maîtrises la suite MSBI (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS) ainsi que l'écosystème SQL Server (SQL avancé, procédures stockées, optimisation).



Tu es très à l'aise sur Power BI (conception de schémas en étoile, DAX) et tu as une première pratique de Power Automate.



Tu maîtrises l'Anglais au niveau Bilingue (C1/C2), indispensable pour échanger au quotidien dans un contexte international.



Une première expérience ou connaissance fonctionnelle du secteur bancaire et/ou des enjeux de cybersécurité est un atout.



Autonome, curieux·se et proactif·ve, tu es reconnu·e pour ton esprit d'analyse et ta capacité à proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins du projet.





Informations supplémentaires



Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ?



Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :



▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours.



▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences.



▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser.



▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir.



▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce.



▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté.



Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous !

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At ING we are looking for a Data Analyst




Your role and work environment:




We are looking for a passionate, high-energy Data Analyst to join our Data Consumption and Culture Team of Data & AI Tribe




Our mission is to unlock business value from data by driving adoption, understanding, governance, and effective consumption of trusted data products. We work side by side with business stakeholders, data product teams, and technology teams to ensure that analytics and reporting are:




- Trusted and governed

- Easy to understand and use

- Focused on real impact and decision-making




We operate in a collaborative, business-oriented and data-driven environment, where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of our DNA.




We are building a team of data partners who help the business make better decisions.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Data Analyst you will:




- Design, build and evolve impactful dashboards and reporting solutions using tools like Power BI and MicroStrategy

- Go beyond reporting: analyze data to generate insights that influence business decisions

- Ensure high standards of data quality, consistency and governance across reporting assets

- Partner with stakeholders to define, challenge and refine KPIs and metrics Translate business needs into clear, scalable and reusable reporting solutions

- Create and maintain functional and technical documentation

- Actively contribute to data adoption and data literacy initiatives across the organization

What are we looking for?




We are looking for someone with drive, curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. If you enjoy working close to the business and turning data into real impact, this role is for you.




Key skills and experience:

- Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, MicroStrategy or similar)

- Strong SQL and data analysis skills

- Ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple way, to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

- Passion for continuous improvement and learning




What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.




Check out what is waiting for you!




Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.




Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!




Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).




Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.




Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…




Free company shuttle.

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.




Banking benefits.

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!




More vitality and more belonging

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

Get to know Us




We are a team of more than 1800 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.




A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.




And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.




We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.




And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.




Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!




At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.




Job Application Safety Reminder




We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

•Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

•Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

•No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).


Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.

Banking benefits.

Title: Data-analist
Description:
Data Analyst




#DataAnalyst #PowerBI #MSFabric #DataDriven #Bouwsector #Analytics #RenotecJobs #WeAreRenotec




Jouw impact als Data Analyst

Bij Renotec maken we elke dag keuzes die impact hebben op onze organisatie. Als Data Analyst zorg jij dat die beslissingen niet op buikgevoel gebeuren, maar op basis van heldere inzichten.

Jij brengt structuur in data over de hele business: van werven en projecten tot ondersteunende diensten. Je maakt verbanden zichtbaar en geeft teams houvast om betere beslissingen te nemen.

Je bouwt geen rapporten om het rapporteren. Je zorgt ervoor dat cijfers richting geven: van budgetopvolging en rendementen tot strategische keuzes.




Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt?

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar data nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Geen vastgeroeste structuren maar ruimte om zelf te bepalen wat relevant is, hoe je het aanpakt en waar je écht het verschil maakt.




Wie zijn wij?

“Bij Renotec combineren we vakmanschap met innovatie om historisch waardevolle gebouwen, kunstwerken, ondergrondse leidingen en monumenten te restaureren en een nieuwe bestemming te geven. We zijn een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf met een duidelijke missie: medewerkers laten groeien en een duurzame toekomst opbouwen. De werksfeer? Energiek, ondersteunend en collegiaal. Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen stempel te drukken en echt impact te maken.”




Wat ga je doen?

Je bouwt en beheert een sterk datafundament: van databronnen tot semantische modellen
Je vertaalt businessvragen naar heldere dashboards en bruikbare inzichten (Power BI)
Je modelleert en optimaliseert data met DAX, T-SQL op een MS Fabric platform
Je bewaakt kwaliteit en governance: toegangen, validatie en correct gebruik van rapporten
Je begeleidt gebruikers en zorgt dat data écht wordt ingezet in de praktijk
Je spot verbeterkansen in processen en vertaalt data naar concrete acties




Wie ben jij?

Je hebt ervaring als Data Analyst / BI Analyst
Je werkt vlot met:
Power BI (visualisaties & datamodellen)
DAX & T-SQL
MS Fabric (of sterke interesse om hierin te groeien)
Je begrijpt hoe data omgezet wordt naar bruikbare inzichten voor business teams
Je denkt kritisch: je ziet niet alleen cijfers, maar ook verbeterkansen
Je communiceert helder en kan complexe analyses simpel uitleggen




Wat bieden we jou?

Bij ons krijg je niet alleen een boeiende job, maar ook een aantrekkelijk en compleet verloningspakket:




Competitief bruto loon – omdat jouw expertise waardevol is.
Netto onkostenvergoeding & dagvergoeding – extra voordelen voor jouw dagelijkse inzet.
Bedrijfswagen + tankkaart – zodat je vlot en zonder zorgen de baan op kan.
Laptop, iPhone, + abonnementen – alles wat je nodig hebt om efficiënt te werken.
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering – zekerheid voor jou en je toekomst.
Deelname in de winst (na 1 jaar) – want succes vieren we samen.
13e maand / flexplan – kies zelf hoe je jouw extra voordelen inzet.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden – blijf groeien met interne en externe trainingen. Groei en ontwikkel je carrière met ons toekomstgericht team
Gezonde werkcultuur – elke middag verse soep, brood en fruit, plus een fitnessruimte.
Toffe collega’s en een hecht team – waar samenwerking en een goede sfeer centraal staan.




Wil jij je carrière naar een hoger niveau tillen en bijdragen aan unieke restauratieprojecten? Solliciteer nu en word deel van ons team!
