Title: Project Administrator
Description:
Bavarian Capital is expanding its support team to assist with a long term engagement involving a client that manages a major logistics network. As we focus on building sustainable value, this role ensures our project documentation and communication channels remain clear and organized. This position is vital for maintaining the steady flow of information required for successful capital management projects.

About the role
The Project Administrator is a foundational position within our remote team, designed for someone who values organization and precision. You will serve as the central point for coordinating schedules, maintaining project logs, and ensuring that all team members have access to the resources they need. Since we operate in a fully remote environment, your ability to document processes and communicate clearly is essential to our collective efficiency. This role is intended for those at the beginning of their professional path who want to learn the fundamentals of project management within a stable investment firm.

What you will do
Maintain and update project schedules to ensure all milestones are recorded accurately.
Organize digital filing systems so that documents are easy to locate and retrieve for all team members.
Assist in the preparation of regular status reports for internal teams and our external partners.
Monitor project timelines and send reminders to colleagues regarding upcoming deadlines and required inputs.
Coordinate remote meetings, including setting agendas and recording detailed meeting notes for later distribution.
Update internal databases with recent developments and data points regarding the logistics network project.
Verify that all project documentation complies with the firm standards for clarity and professional tone.
Distribute relevant information to the correct team members to prevent communication bottlenecks and ensure transparency.
Provide general administrative support to the project team to help maintain a steady workflow.



What we are looking for
A strong ability to organize tasks and prioritize daily responsibilities effectively without constant oversight.
Clear and professional written communication skills for documentation, reporting, and email correspondence.
Basic familiarity with standard office software, spreadsheets, and digital collaboration tools.
A methodical approach to problem solving and a high degree of attention to detail in all tasks.
The ability to work independently in a remote setting while staying connected to the team.
Curiosity about capital management and a genuine willingness to learn about the logistics sector.
A reliable and consistent work ethic that aligns with our firm long term goals and professional standards.
The capacity to handle routine administrative tasks with precision, care, and a focus on accuracy.



What we offer
A permanent, full-time position with a stable and respected investment firm.
A fully remote work arrangement that allows you to work effectively from your own professional space.
Competitive pay that is attractive for an entry level professional in today's market.
A calm and focused professional environment where your individual work is respected and valued.
Opportunities to learn about complex logistics networks and the mechanics of capital management strategies.
A culture that values professional autonomy, straightforward communication, and mutual respect.
Regular feedback and support from experienced team members to help you grow within your role.
The necessary resources and digital tools to perform your duties effectively in a remote capacity.



Working at Bavarian Capital
Working at Bavarian Capital means joining a team that prizes stability and sound reasoning above all else. We do not react to every market trend, choosing instead to focus on building lasting value through careful analysis and disciplined work. Our remote first model is a core part of how we operate, providing our team members with the space to focus on their craft without unnecessary distractions or the stress of a commute. We believe that by treating each other with mutual respect and maintaining a steady, reliable pace, we produce better results for our clients and our partners. This is a professional home for those who appreciate a straightforward approach to business and the chance to build a meaningful career in a quiet, productive atmosphere where diligence is the standard.

Title: Information Security Analyst
Description:
Hey! We're Scale Up, and our client is looking to hire a Information Security Analyst.

Type of Employment: Contractor (Long-term)

Work Modality: 100% Remote

Work Schedule: Full-time

Time Zone: U.S. Pacific Time (PST) with overlap during business hours

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based cybersecurity and compliance consulting firm that partners with technology startups to strengthen their security posture and achieve compliance with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and more.

They act as an extension of their clients' security teams, providing GRC consulting, audit readiness, vendor risk management, and virtual CISO services. As the company continues to grow, they are expanding their team with professionals who enjoy working across multiple clients in a fast-paced consulting environment.

About The Role

You'll own the vendor security questionnaire process from end to end across multiple client accounts.

You'll work closely with U.S.-based startups, monitoring incoming security requests, coordinating with technical stakeholders, and completing security questionnaires accurately and on time. This role requires a solid understanding of security frameworks, strong organizational skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in GRC, security compliance, or vendor risk who enjoys supporting multiple clients and playing a key role in helping companies close enterprise deals.

Key Responsibilities


Monitor client Slack channels and respond promptly to incoming security questionnaire requests.
Create and manage tickets in Jira, Linear, or other ticketing systems to track requests through completion.
Complete vendor security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, custom questionnaires) through spreadsheets and security platforms such as OneTrust, Whistic, SecurityScorecard, and similar tools.
Develop a deep understanding of each client's security posture, policies, controls, and technical environment.
Maintain and continuously improve client answer libraries and knowledge bases.
Coordinate with security consultants, engineers, and subject matter experts whenever technical clarification is needed.
Escalate recurring gaps or missing controls that impact questionnaire responses.
Ensure all questionnaires are completed accurately and within customer deadlines.


Requirements


2–4 years of experience completing vendor security questionnaires, working in GRC/compliance, or in a security-related client-facing role.
Hands-on experience completing SIG, CAIQ, or custom vendor security questionnaires.
Working knowledge of SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Understanding of common security concepts, including:
Single Sign-On (SSO)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Endpoint Management
Encryption (at rest & in transit)
Cloud infrastructure fundamentals
Backup & Disaster Recovery
Vendor Risk Management
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously.
Excellent judgment regarding when to answer independently and when to involve technical SMEs.
Excellent written communication skills.
Professional English (written and spoken).

Nice to Have


Experience handling a high volume of vendor security questionnaires.
Experience with:
Conveyor
SafeBase
Vanta
Whistic
Trust Center platforms
Experience maintaining questionnaire knowledge bases.
Experience working alongside Sales or Revenue teams supporting enterprise deals.
Certifications such as:
CompTIA Security+
ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
Similar cybersecurity certifications

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Supply Chain, EU Supply Chain Engineering
Description:
Description

Role Overview

Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth’s most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfillment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.

The SC Engineering, EThOS team builds tech solutions for cross-functional Supply Chain & Under-The-Roof business problems. We work closely with Global Tech teams such as Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) and AFT (Amazon Fulfillment Technologies) teams in North America, who own Buying, Placement, UTR systems that control the flow of inventory across our network and processing within our Fulfillment Centers. Our internal stakeholders are EU ACES, Supply Chain Execution, across all three miles, GOX, Fulfillment Optimization, Inbound & Inventory Placement.

If you are someone who has is interested & shown success in analyzing, diving deep in complex data, building models & tech artifacts that improve business processes and pioneering new ways to do things, we’d like to talk to you.

Responsibilities

Within our team, you will get the opportunity to work closely with Software Engineers, Applied Scientists and Data Engineers to build models, data solutions and automation of planning processes.

You will be involved in the development of critical tech initiatives that will allow us to offer best possible speed and delivery promise to our customers while incurring the lowest cost to serve,

About The Team

Supply Chain Engineering is team within EThOS (ACES) org that delivers tech solutions to complex cross-functional business problems.

Basic Qualifications


Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
Experience with SQL
Experience in the data/BI space


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
Knowledge of how to improve code quality and optimizes BI processes (e.g. speed, cost, reliability)

Als QC Data Analist ga je tijdelijk aan de slag bij een internationaal opererende organisatie binnen de agrarische sector. Je werkt in een innovatieve werkomgeving waar kwaliteit, digitalisering en procesverbetering centraal staan. Samen met collega's uit binnen- en buitenland zorg je voor betrouwbare data, slimme rapportages en waardevolle inzichten die bijdragen aan betere processen. Zet jouw analytische talent in binnen een professionele werkomgeving en solliciteer vandaag nog!

Als QC Data Analist zorg jij ervoor dat de kwaliteitsdata betrouwbaar, volledig en actueel is. Je beheert verschillende databronnen, maakt duidelijke rapportages en dashboards en vertaalt data naar waardevolle inzichten. Zo help je de afdeling Quality Control om processen te verbeteren en onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen.

Dit zijn je taken:



Je beheert en controleert kwaliteitsdata in systemen zoals SAP, LIMS en Power BI.
Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en verbetert dashboards, KPI's en managementrapportages.
Je analyseert data, signaleert afwijkingen en vertaalt jouw inzichten naar verbeteringen in processen en datakwaliteit.
Je werkt samen met collega's uit binnen- en buitenland om rapportages, KPI's en datastromen te standaardiseren en te optimaliseren.
Je ondersteunt de afdeling Quality Control bij complexe data-analyses, digitaliseringsprojecten en andere verbeterinitiatieven.



Het gaat om een tijdelijke functie.

Ontdek jouw toekomstige werkplek

Het bedrijf waar je werkt is een groot, internationaal bedrijf gespecialiseerd in tuinbouw en veredeling. Dit is het onderzoeken en verbeteren van planten. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

Covenir is a BPO partner to insurance carriers — and increasingly, a technology company that happens to serve them. The Platform is how that shows up day to day: modules spanning Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox, built with an AI-assisted, 80/20 development model where AI handles the first draft and people handle the judgment. The Data Analyst owns the data and reporting that support Covenir’s business — building and maintaining the analytics that give Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership a single, trustworthy view of performance, while scouting the AI tools and partnerships that inform Covenir’s build-versus-partner decisions. The Platform is this role’s current top priority, but scope extends to Covenir’s broader data and reporting needs as priorities shift.

Job Description

How Covenir’s Values Show Up in This Role


Committed to WOW our Customers: The dashboards and numbers you produce are what leadership uses to make real calls — you make sure they’re right, not just plausible.
Great Just Isn’t Good Enough: You don’t stop at a working report. You ask if the metric is actually the right one, and if there’s a cleaner way to show it.
One Team, One Goal: Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT/R&D all come to you with different questions — you treat all of them as your team, not just IT.
Passion for Excellence: Your analysis is clean enough that someone unfamiliar with the data could follow your logic without a walkthrough.


What You’ll Do


Write SQL for data extraction, transformation, and reporting across Covenir’s systems
Build and maintain executive-facing analytics and KPI dashboards — volumes, postage, and SLA performance by customer and business unit
Use Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) supporting the platform’s data warehouse
Research and evaluate AI tools, vendors, and partnership opportunities (for example, document-intelligence platforms) to inform build-versus-partner recommendations
Translate operational and business questions from Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership into data requests and reporting
Apply AI-assisted analysis and workflow tools, consistent with Covenir’s 80/20 model
Support data retention, security, and SOC compliance requirements as they apply to platform data


Requirements


2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with proficient SQL skills
Working knowledge of Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) or equivalent cloud data tools; AWS experience a plus
Fundamental knowledge of insurance BPO business processes across Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox
Working knowledge of data collection across multiple business functions, and of data retention and access-control policies
Basic understanding of the AI/API sandbox and its available data workflows
Experience building executive-facing dashboards or KPI reporting
Comfortable researching and evaluating vendors, tools, or partnership opportunities
Ability to create clear, concise data analysis and reporting documentation for stakeholders across Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT & R&D
Completes data security and confidentiality training, SOC compliance training, and cross-functional onboarding across Platform modules
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business), or equivalent experience
Performs other duties as assigned by the R&D Manager in support of Covenir’s broader business needs


What An A Player Looks Like


Numbers you can defend. A players can explain exactly how a metric was calculated and why it’s the right one, not just hand over a dashboard.
Translates business questions into data. When Sales & Marketing or Operations asks a vague question, A players know how to turn it into the right query.
Curious about AI tooling. A players actively track what’s out there, not just when asked to evaluate a specific vendor.
Comfortable being the single source of truth. When numbers conflict across teams, A players are the ones who resolve which version is right.
Documents the logic, not just the output. A players leave behind reporting anyone can pick up, not a black box only they understand.


Is This Role For You?

Strong fit


Proficient in SQL and comfortable owning data
extraction, transformation, and reporting end to end
Enjoys translating vague business questions into
concrete data requests
Genuinely curious about AI tools and vendor
landscapes, not just the data itself
Comfortable being the tie-breaker when numbers
across teams don’t match


Skip this role if


You want a narrowly scoped reporting role with no ambiguity
You’re not interested in researching AI tools or vendors
You’d rather avoid being the one who resolves conflicting numbers
You need requests to come from a single, consistent source

Description:
Pay Range

$83,200.00 - $124,800.00

Please email HR_Talent_AcquisitionTeam@bcbsri.org if you are a candidate seeking a reasonable accommodation for the application and/or interview process.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.

We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.

It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.

We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join Others Who Value a Workplace For All.

We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.

Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why This Job Matters

Analyze, define, maintain, and manage business data contained within the enterprise data warehouse. Map and verify data from new data sources into the warehouse, ensuring the integrity of the data. Maintain operational and user-facing data documentation.

What You Will Do


Work with business stakeholders to understand business requirements for changes to business processes, policies and information systems to shape their needs into documentation (System Requirement Specification, Source to Target Mapping) that developers and testers can use to create the proper technical solution.
Profile, analyze, and transform data in existing datastores and work with third party vendors to understand their capabilities and data sources in order to shape functional requirements and source to target mapping rules for the development team.
Work with the business community to communicate and validate functional designs (ingestion, transformation, extraction) for data ingestion or extraction to ensure proper functionality of ELT processes.
Support the business and technical stakeholders throughout projects. Help them understand what data is available in the data warehouse and ingest new data sources. Serve as a liaison and translator between end-user community and the corporate technical resources. Participate in SDLC activities including requirements refinement, design reviews, testing support, and production validation.
Define and maintain user-facing data documentation and definitions for the data warehouse.
Analyze and improve operational processes and documentation related to maintaining the data warehouse.
Define data validation rules and perform data reconciliation to ensure accuracy and completeness of data within the warehouse. Investigate and remediate data quality issues in partnership with various teams.
Perform other duties as assigned.


What You Need To Succeed


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Three to five years experience with database management systems, business intelligence tools and systems
Data warehouse or data mart experience
Experience on an operations or development team
Experience with system analysis, data engineering, or equivalent, with project management and SDLC experience
Advanced analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and synthesize complex business processes and data sets
Intermediate SQL skills for analysis, validation, and troubleshooting
Data modeling
Familiarity with Python
Familiarity with cloud computing concepts
Familiarity with data dictionaries and metadata repositories
Familiarity with various Business Intelligence tools
Good business acumen and political savvy
Knowledge of business process improvement techniques and strategies
Excellent verbal and written communications skills
Negotiation skills
Presentation skills
Decision-making skills
Good problem-solving skills
Ability to interface with employees with different skillsets
Ability to effectively navigate ambiguous situations with limited direction
Excellent organizational skills and ability to successfully prioritize multiple tasks
Ability to handle multiple priorities/projects


The Extras


Master’s in Business Administration or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field
HIAA Certification
Knowledge of the health insurance industry and systems
Experience with data warehouse platforms, ETL, and BI tools
Experience with data governance


Location:

Role

BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:


In-office: onsite 5 days per week
Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia


Our culture of belonging at Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island (BCBSRI) is at the core of all we do, and it strengthens our ability to meet the challenges of today’s healthcare industry. BCBSRI is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data team, you will join forces with the Senior Analytics Engineer in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants.

This position will play an important role in building and maintaining resilient, scalable data pipelines and company-wide data infrastructure that empowers Purple Carrot employees to better understand, manage, curate, and analyze the data most relevant to their work.

As the Analytics Engineer, you will be focused on maintaining and improving our data pipelines, supporting data systems and analytics, and helping develop rigorous data products within our modern data stack. This role will synthesize feedback from teams across the business and help translate data needs into reliable, well-documented solutions that allow us to move faster and gain better insights into how our business performs.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.

Description:
Who We AreButcherBox is a certified B Corp headquartered in Boston, and honored to be celebrating our fourth year in a row on Inc.'s list of Best Workplaces. At ButcherBox, we believe in better. That’s why we deliver 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef, free-range organic chicken, pork raised crate-free, and wild-caught seafood directly to our members’ doors. All of our products are humanely raised or wild-caught and never given antibiotics or added hormones ever. We’re working to build a world that’s better for all, and we’re inviting everyone to come along. For us, better means treating our planet with respect. It means improving the lives of animals and the livelihoods of farmers. It means never cutting corners when it comes to doing business. Ultimately, it means better meals, enjoyed together. Our team is made up of people who collaborate and support one another. We’re always looking for outstanding people to join our mission! 

About the Role

Department: Commercial Operations

Reports To: Associate Director of Commercial & Marketing Analytics

Location: Watertown, MA - in office 3 days/week 

Level: Individual Contributor, mid-level

Base Salary: $103,000 - $120,000

 

About the Role

ButcherBox is looking for a Growth Analyst to own new member acquisition analytics. This isn't a build-dashboards-and-hand-off-findings role. You'll identify opportunities, design tests, drive analysis, and follow it through to a decision. The expectation is that you're the connective tissue between data and action; not just telling us what the numbers say, but making sure something happens because of it. 

Our marketing and commercial teams embrace a hybrid model that provides personal flexibility as well as in-person collaboration. The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office two to three days per week. You’ll be embedded in the growth team, owning critical metrics alongside them and supporting weekly channel deep dives. 

Responsibilities

Own analysis across paid (social, SEM, affiliate) and non-digital channels (TV, radio, podcast, OOH), plus site funnel and lead/email flow — from surfacing what's happening to advising what to do next 
Design, analyze, and report on A/B and incrementality tests with a bias toward action and iteration 
Build and maintain self-service reporting tools and data resources that enable self-service analytics by the growth team 
Lead the development of our next phase of media attribution, including MTA and media mix  
Build a deep understanding of the new member journey (predictive LTV, LTV:CPA, funnel conversion) and use it to sharpen acquisition strategy 
Translate analytical findings into decisions in partnership with the growth marketing team 
Drive work from question to answer to outcome, including identifying and resolving whatever's in the way 

Qualifications

Excellent SQL skills; proficiency in Power BI or other visualization tools 
Experience in paid media analytics and growth marketing measurement 
Deep knowledge of incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, and other measurement tools 
Strong sense of “so what?”, driving action through analysis 
Comfort working in a fast paced environment where decisions cannot wait to be made 
Ability to translate technical analysis into clear, specific recommendations, communicated clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders 
Track record of driving projects to closure in cross-functional environments, including navigating ambiguity and multiple priorities, with a bias towards speed 

 

What We OfferOur ValuesWe are a mission-driven company and strive to embody our values in every step of the process. ButcherBox is driven by relentless improvement, accountability, humility, and customer obsession. We want our workplace to be one of growth and learning where everyone can be safe/comfortable to show up as their authentic self to work. Anyone who loves our products and goals is welcome here! We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer aspiring to incite positive change in the pastures, the fulfillment centers, the office, and the world. Benefits•Health: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, an employer-funded HSA, and short & long-term disability benefits•Financial: 401(k) with generous employer match•Annual bonus based on company performance•Time off: unlimited paid time off policy, 20 weeks parental leave, an executive team that encourages a good work/life balance•Personal growth: Annual Learning & Development stipend, and access to a range of personal and professional coaching solutions through BetterUp•Food: a free Custom Classic ButcherBox each month and weekly lunch reimbursement•Others: reimbursement for wellness activities, an exceptional EAP, fertility benefits, life insurance and more ButcherBox is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment at all steps in the hiring process. Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Our Brand

At J.Jill, we’re redefining what it means to dress and live with ease. As a women-led, Boston-based lifestyle brand with 200+ stores nationwide, we design thoughtful, inspired apparel and accessories that celebrate the totality of all women. We’re entering an exciting chapter of growth — expanding our footprint, reaching new customers, and deepening long-standing relationships. We're seeking bold thinkers and doers to join us. With competitive pay and benefits, a supportive culture, and the chance to make a real impact, this is more than a job, it’s an opportunity to bring our ethos keep it simple, make it matter to life in new and inspiring ways.

Overview

The Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams across J.Jill, including Real Estate, Marketing, Retail Operations, and Merchandising, to provide data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. This role performs end-to-end business analysis by translating business questions into actionable recommendations through SQL queries, Excel spreadsheets, and data visualization. The Business Analyst evaluates business performance, analyzes A/B testing results, develops automated reporting solutions using BI tools such as Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI, and presents findings through clear, impactful presentations and reports. Additionally, the role supports real estate strategy by developing sales forecasts for new store locations, closures, and transfers to help drive profitable growth.

Responsibilities


Builds partnerships and operates cross functionally to provide analytical decision support to leaders to increase revenue and profit of various initiatives.
Takes an active role in conception, design, execution, and analysis of corporate-wide testing activities.
Understands key performance indicators that drive company results and determines how these metrics track against overall business strategies, goals and objectives.
Takes initiative acting as a subject matter expert on analytics, quantification, and process automation and provides advanced analytics to support longer-range plans and initiatives.
Provides recommendations for improvements to tools, scorecards, KPIs & benchmarks.
Performs end-to-end business analytics: 1) Understands business question 2) Structures Excel spreadsheet 3) Builds accurate SQL queries (validating results) 4) Summarizes analytical insights and business recommendations into a PowerPoint deck and/or email.
Performs data analysis tasks, evalution of A/B Tests, etc. to develop recommendations that will improve decision making across the organization.
Develops automated self-service business reporting through BI tools including Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI.
Calculates sales estimates for potential new store locations as well as store closure and store transfer estimates for existing stores.


Benefits, Tailored for You.


401(k) retirement plan with discretionary match and tuition reimbursement.
Medical, dental, vision, company paid LTD/STD, and generous amount of paid time off.
Generous associate discount; group discounts on auto, pet and homeowner insurance.
Discount Marketplace for travel, consumer products, food, auto buying, etc.
Associate resource groups.


Qualifications


Advanced SQL skills required; experience with statistical predictive analytics tools like R and Python preferred.
Natural analytical curiosity is essential.
Must demonstrate attention to detail and accuracy, a high degree of organization, and have pride in work.
Desire to continuously learn, ability to learn quickly and confidence to ask questions to gain clarity are required.
Strong aptitude with MS Office tools, especially advanced Excel skills.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Tableau) preferred.
Self-motivated with an ability to both work independently as well as collaboratively across functions and business areas.
Ability to not only retrieve and report data, but to also analyze the implications and make recommendations on various key business questions.
Excellent written and verbal communication/follow-up skills (follow up with project partners to ensure accurate and timely completion of deliverables).
Exposure to retail metrics (sales, inventory, UPT, conversion rates, etc.) preferred.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and consistently meet deadlines.


Education & Experience


3+ years of business experience in an analytical or technical role.
Advanced Excel and SQL skills required.
Statistical analysis and predictive modeling (R, Python) experience preferred.

Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Equis Analyst
Description:
Position Overview

Roux is seeking a Database Analyst with hands-on experience using EarthSoft’s EQuIS to support the management of environmental and chemical data for analysis and reporting. The ideal candidate is an experienced analyst with a desire to grow who can execute day-to-day EDD processing and project support while also supporting EQuIS database administration, configuration, and client-facing dashboard/reporting capabilities. This role will work closely with Roux’s existing environmental data management team as we expand Roux’s EQuIS-based service offerings. Candidate is expected to work from the Burlington, Massachusetts office three days per week at minimum.

Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree or higher in relevant technical field.
Minimum of 4 years of environmental data management experience, including practical use of EarthSoft’s EQuIS in a consulting or regulated environment.
Demonstrated experience processing and QA/QC’ing laboratory EDDs efficiently using EQuIS (EDP) (or comparable EDD workflow).
Working knowledge of EQuIS configuration/administration concepts.
Strong skills and proficiency with Microsoft-based software, including MS Access and MS Excel.
Interest and aptitude for building client-facing outputs (dashboards/reporting) using EQuIS dashboards.
Basic to intermediate SQL skills for querying, troubleshooting, and supporting reports/dashboards.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple project priorities and tight schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordination with project managers, laboratories, and technical staff.
Ability to help build and scale Roux’s EQuIS capabilities by training and supporting other staff, including analysts with prior database experience.


Essential Duties


Support environmental project teams by managing, processing, and quality‑checking environmental data in EQuIS to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, and suitable for reporting, compliance, and analysis.
Collaborate closely with project managers, scientists, engineers, and GIS staff to understand project requirements, prioritize data tasks, and deliver high‑quality data support under tight timelines.
Process laboratory and field EDDs in EQuIS (EDP), perform QA/QC and completeness checks, resolve common errors efficiently, and coordinate corrections with labs and project staff.
Support routine data tracking, data loading, and data delivery workflows.
Develop, run, and refine standard queries (SQL-based or within EQuIS) and reports to support project reporting needs.
Assist with EQuIS database administration and configuration activities, including management of reference values, formats, templates, and standard reports.
Develop client‑facing dashboards and reporting solutions (e.g., EQuIS-based and/or Power BI), working with project teams to translate technical data into clear, usable outputs for clients.
Help document workflows, QA/QC procedures, and guidance materials that improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across Roux’s EQuIS‑based data management services.
Provide hands‑on training and ongoing support to other staff in the use of EQuIS and related data management workflows, enabling consistent and effective use of the system across projects.

Description:
Description


While Citizens does provide work authorization sponsorship for some roles, this role is not eligible. Applicants must be fully authorized to work without sponsorship now or in the futrure


The Business Insights Analyst will support the End-to-End Servicing Journey Reimagination initiative by providing targeted analysis, insight generation, and operational reporting needed to inform design, delivery, and go‑live decisions. This role will report into the business organization, with day‑to‑day analytical direction from Enterprise Data and Analytics. The role is execution‑focused and will work closely with Business Intelligence (BI), operations, and initiative teams to translate servicing requirements into actionable metrics, analyses, and decision support.

This position is well‑suited for an analytically strong individual who can operate in a delivery environment—balancing structured analysis with evolving requirements and partnering closely with business and data teams to ensure insights are decision‑relevant and operationally grounded.

Key Responsibilities

Workstream Analytics & Decision Support


Perform analyses to support End‑to‑End Servicing design and delivery, including readiness and go‑live decisioning (e.g., analysis of QC results, defect trends, and operational performance indicators).
Translate workstream requirements into clear analytical questions and develop analyses to address them using available data sources.
Synthesize findings into concise, decision‑oriented insights for business, product, and delivery leadership.


Operational Metrics & Reporting


Partner with business stakeholders and BI teams to define, refine, and operationalize servicing metrics aligned to workstream objectives.
Support development and validation of recurring and ad‑hoc reporting to track performance, risk, and outcomes across servicing journeys.
Ensure metric definitions, assumptions, and limitations are clearly documented and consistently applied.


Data Quality & Validation


Conduct data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of analyses and reports.
Identify data limitations, biases, or gaps and clearly communicate implications for interpretation and decision‑making.
Support issue triage by analyzing root causes and patterns within operational and QC data.


Cross‑Functional Coordination


Act as an analytical liaison between the End‑to‑End Servicing workstream, business partners, and BI teams.
Coordinate inputs, timelines, and deliverables across stakeholders to support workstream milestones.
Build strong working relationships with business, operations, technology, and data partners.


Qualifications


2–4 years of professional experience in an analytical, business insights, or business analysis role.
Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to operate independently on well‑defined analytical tasks.
Proficiency with data analysis tools (e.g., Python, SQL, Excel), with Python experience strongly preferred; experience working with BI is a plus.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to uncover insights from data and articulate a clear, evidence‑based story and implications for decision‑making.
Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, economics, finance, or a related quantitative field.


Additional Characteristics


Comfortable working in a dynamic delivery environment with evolving priorities.
Detail‑oriented with a strong commitment to analytical rigor and data integrity.
Collaborative, pragmatic, and focused on enabling progress and decision‑making rather than theoretical analysis.


Hours & Work Schedule


Hours per Week: 40
Work Schedule: Monday - Friday
Hybrid: 4 days per week on-site
Office location(s): Johnston, RI; or Westwood, MA


Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $106,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Title: Product Analyst
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring Product Analysts to embed across the product organization and serve as strategic analytics partners to teams across Healthcare, Algorithms, AI, Hardware, and other product areas. In this role, you will help define how WHOOP measures product success, uncover insights that shape roadmap decisions, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve the member experience. You will bring strong analytical rigor, product intuition, and intellectual curiosity to help teams make faster, smarter, and more impactful decisions with data.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, and cross-functional leadership to inform strategy and roadmap decisions with data.
Own the analytical narrative for your product area, illustrated by defining KPIs, refining measurement frameworks, and surfacing insights that drive action.
Support experimentation and feature launches end-to-end: from defining success metrics to post-launch analysis and iteration.
Build scalable, self-serve reporting & tooling that lets your stakeholders make decisions without waiting on you.
Develop deep context on your product domain and use it to ask sharper questions, challenge assumptions, and push the product forward.
Proactively surface insights and recommendations that go beyond the ask; identify opportunities others haven't seen yet.
Collaborate with a high-performance analytics team in a fast-paced environment where intellectual curiosity is the baseline expectation.


Qualifications


You've done this before: 2-6+ years in an analytical role where you owned business-critical metrics or initiatives. (We're hiring across levels; we'll figure out the right fit together.)
You use AI tools proactively and hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own.
You can take a vague question, wrangle the right data, isolate insights, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders who aren't data people.
You're a strong storyteller: you know how to make a compelling, concise case for action.
You're technically sharp: advanced SQL is table stakes. Familiarity with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows) and visualization tools (Hex, Sigma, Amplitude, Looker) is a plus.
You have product sense: you think about the member experience, not just the numbers.
You're curious about how things work. Algorithms, hardware, health science: you don't need to be an expert, but you should want to understand.
You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and doesn't wait to be told what to work on.
TEAMS WE'RE HIRING FOR


We’re Looking For Multiple Analysts To Work Across Our Product Teams. During The Interview Process, We'll Work With You To Find The Right Team Fit Based On Your Interests And Strengths


AI Product: The future of intelligent coaching and personalized insights powered by AI/ML.
Algorithms: Where the science meets the product; sleep, recovery, strain, and how algorithmic outputs translate into member value.
Hardware Product: The physical device experience; sensors, wearability, and next-gen hardware.
Healthcare Product: Building WHOOP's Health Operating System; health outcomes, clinical features, personalized wellness.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Analytical Support / Program Analyst with Security Clearance
Description:
Quantech has an immediate opening for a Data Business Analyst supporting the AFNWC PEO located at Hanscom AFB, MA. This role focuses on leveraging business intelligence and predictive analytics to drive data-driven solutions for program and acquisition management. Specific duties include but are not limited to the following:


The Candidate shall utilize business intelligence data for predictive analytics and facilitate the implementation of enterprise tools such as Tableau, Qlik Sense, PMRT, and Power BI.
The Candidate shall administer quantitative and qualitative modeling techniques using Microsoft Excel alongside modern visualization platforms.
The Candidate shall apply analytical best practices for data collection, aggregation, normalization, and analysis to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
The Candidate shall create and maintain data models and report templates while developing dynamic solutions using data engineering tools like Databricks or low-code/no-code applications (e.g., Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse).
The Candidate shall recommend and implement key performance measures, including efficiency tracking and other statistical metrics.
The Candidate shall provide customers with detailed, actionable reports documenting findings from data analysis to support program, financial, and acquisition management activities. JOB REQUIREMENTS
SECRET Clearance required (or ability to obtain).
Experience:
3+ years in data visualization, data management, governance, strategy, or data engineering.
2+ years of experience designing and maintaining analytics platforms using Tableau and Power BI.
2+ years of experience in client engagement, requirement identification, and solution implementation.
Education: Bachelor's degree in a technical field preferred; Master's degree in an analytical field is a plus.
The Candidate must demonstrate experience querying data to solve complex problems and communicating key insights through visualization.
The Candidate must be able to learn quickly and adapt to changing organizational processes and data environments.
Technical "Nice to Haves": Experience with SQL, Microsoft Power Query, and app development within the Microsoft Power Platform (Apps, Automate, Dataverse). We hire Military! Salary Information: Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as business and market considerations. Salary Range: $120,000 - $135,000

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data department, you will join forces with the Sr. Manager, Data and Analytics (to whom you will also report) in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants!

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about transforming and analyzing complex datasets into clear, actionable, and timely insights that drive strategic decision-making and improve business results.

As the Senior Data Analyst, you will be focused on leveraging SQL, Python, and BI tools to identify opportunities, optimize key metrics, and measure performance across the organization. This is a high-visibility role that partners directly and frequently with senior leadership, translating data into high-quality analysis to support the decisions the business acts on. You'll also work closely with marketing and other teams across the organization to help them become proficient in the data assets you produce. You'll be part of a small data analytics team, so your work is visible, and your voice matters.

If you are a detail-oriented problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of data, analysis, and strategy, we'd like to meet you.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.


Location


This role is based in Dedham, MA, 3 days per week in the office
Our hybrid approach includes 3 in-office days each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Query and analyze large datasets to extract and communicate meaningful insights
Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using SQL, Python, and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Build and apply machine learning models in Python — from predictive modeling (e.g., cancel/churn prediction, demand forecasting) to applied techniques (e.g., clustering, regression) that generate deeper analytical insight
Train and support teams on the data assets you build, so they have what they need to self-serve
Own forecasting and experimentation initiatives end-to-end, from framework design through measurement and recommendation
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand what they actually need and provide data-driven solutions
Produce clear reports, visualizations, and presentations for leadership, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority
Monitor and report on key performance indicators and emerging trends
Assist with ad hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


3+ years' experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar analytical role
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science/Analytics) or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days/week
Proficient in SQL for data querying and transformation
Skilled in Python - for advanced analysis and automation, including building and running machine learning models
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Strong Excel skills for analysis and reporting



Extra Special Sauce


A collaborative team player who thrives on a small analytics team
You love teaching almost as much as you love a clean dataset - nothing makes you happier than watching a teammate go from confused to confident
You've got opinions, and you're not afraid to share them - pushing back when it's the right call, not just going along to get along
You are adaptable to a fast-paced working environment with changing priorities based on the business needs
Genuine curiosity about the "why" behind the numbers, not just the "what."
Experience with dbt or modern data stack tools is a plus



Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $95,000 - $115,000. Compensation is based on experience and qualifications, and the posted range is not a guarantee of any specific offer.

Garnish

We love our staff, and show it with benefits (including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA, and life insurance), matching retirement plan, generous and flexible paid time off, Purple Carrot box delivery credits, professional development, and the opportunity to work in collaboration with teammates who are passionate about food!

Final Touches

We are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment, free of discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetics, national origin, ancestry, age, medical condition, mental or physical disability, handicap, veteran status, or marital status.

Title: Timberland: Analyst, Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness
Description:
At Timberland, we’re a force of nature. We’re a team that steps outside, works hard together, and moves the world forward. The brand is widely recognized as the arbiter of boot culture. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and an eye toward the future, Timberland has a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and build community.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with an team of fun, adventure-loving people, Timberland just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Timberland Careers or www.timberland.com.

Timberland: Analyst, Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness

What will you do?

The Analyst, Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness will lead the efforts to measure, optimize, and report on all working marketing investments. Working within the North America Marketing organization, they will regularly collaborate with full marketing organization, the Americas business organization, our global brand partners, and external agencies. This role will be pivotal in setting the objective framework for marketing and helping drive clear, measurable incremental results. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Media, Retention and Analytics. It is a hybrid role, working 3 days/week out of our headquarters in Stratham, NH.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.


Lead the creation of best-in-class marketing reporting, blending platform and business data through data visualization to help marketing leadership have better insight into holistic marketing performance.
Working with key regional marketing leads to help them better understand and optimize their channels through data visualization and storytelling.
Partner with regional teams on A/B testing, brand lift studies, and all other forms of data backed learning agendas with the intent of driving constant organizational growth.
Partner with Sr Manager on setup and review of all major measurement milestones with key agency and media partners. Help establish new processes of communicating learnings across regional, global, and corporate organizations.
Partner with Sr Manager on ad hoc reporting requests to help identify consumer trends, understand business challenges, and determine opportunities to help achieve short-term and long-term business objectives for the region.
Partner with Sr Manager to continue to develop best in class marketing measurement by blending Mixed Media Modeling, Incrementality Testing, and Attribution to create a clear statistical perspective on investment choices.
Manager bi-annual data collection process for our Mix Media Modeling Studies and help establish key business questions and associated needs.
Become the subject matter expert on marketing measurement techniques including incrementality, mixed media modeling and 3rd party data platforms.


What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 3+ years of experience and professional achievements or a Bachelors/Master’s with a distinct focus in Marketing Measurement/Analytics.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:


Excellent data analytics skills with hand on experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or PowerBI.
Proven ability to translate complex data into simple, actional stories for key business partners.
Experience working with digital marketing data set platforms like Salesforce Marketing Cloud, GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads, with a focus on analyzing performance metrics and extracting actionable insights.
Strong interpersonal skills to create and foster relationships across the organization based on trust and transparency.
A foundational understanding of the core principles of marketing measurement and modern marketing measurement frameworks.


There are also a few skills that are not required but preferred.


Certifications with Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or other popular data visualization tools
Certifications in platforms like Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, or TikTik Business Manager
Experience with Consumer Data and Consumer Data Insights
Experience with 3rd party data platforms like SimilarWeb, SEMRush, Google Trends or other data research platforms.
Experience with website infrastructure and data tracking


Now WE have a question for YOU.

Are you in?

$68,000.00 USD - $85,000.00 USD annually

Incentive Potential: This position is eligible for additional compensation awards that may include an annual incentive plan, sales incentive, or commission potential. Title: Data Platform Analyst
Description:
Company Profile

Founded in 1977, GMO is a global investment manager committed to delivering superior long-term investment performance and advice to our clients. We offer investment strategies and solutions where we believe we are positioned to add the greatest value for our investors. These include multi-asset class, equity, fixed income and alternative offerings.

We manage approximately $80bn for a client base that includes many of the world’s most sophisticated institutions, financial intermediaries, and private clients. Industry-wide, we are well known for our focus on valuation-based investing, willingness to take bold positions when conditions warrant, and candid and academically rigorous thought leadership. Jeremy Grantham, GMO’s Co-Founder and Long-Term Investment Strategist, is renowned as an expert in identifying speculative investment bubbles and also as a leading climate investor and advocate.

GMO is privately owned and employs over 430 people worldwide. We are headquartered in Boston, with additional offices in Europe, Asia and Australia. Our company-wide culture emphasizes commitment to clients, intellectual curiosity, and open debate. We celebrate and respect our differences, while embracing and valuing what each of us brings to work, as we know that diverse teams in an inclusive, caring environment achieve higher engagement and better client results.

Please follow the prompts included in this job posting to apply. The application window for this role is anticipated to remain open until the job is filled, or as otherwise determined by GMO.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Platform Analyst to join GMO’s Data Engineering and Operations team within the Technology group. This role offers an opportunity for a seasoned Analyst to leverage their financial reference data and enterprise data platforms experience to evolve GMO’s security master data and portfolio data platforms. Partnering with GMO’s Operations and Investment teams, a successful candidate will translate operational insight into scalable workflow, control, automation, and data quality improvements. They will bring deep experience in Neoxam’s DataHub application and a proven track record leading or supporting security master conversions and data platform migrations.

The position will be based in Boston where GMO is currently operating in a hybrid work model, with the current expectation that this person will be in the office for a minimum of 2 days per week and the balance of the week working either in the office or remotely.

Responsibilities


Develop an expert understanding of GMO’s reference data flow within internal databases and vendor applications: BlackRock Aladdin, NeoXam DataHub, and Eagle PACE
Act as the NeoXam DataHub application subject matter expert: validate portfolio master and other reference data, resolve production issues, and ensure scalable integration with downstream systems
Through hands-on operational execution, identify recurring issues, process gaps, and data quality risks; translate findings into business requirements and recommendations for workflow, control, automation, and data quality improvements
Analyze data in multiple databases and use a combination of vendor toolsets, Python, SQL, and Excel to develop recommendations to improve data quality
Support the design, governance, and transformation activities for portfolio, security master, and reference data across enterprise platforms, including data model review, conversion analysis, controls, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment
Think critically to help automate or improve processes and procedures (e.g. control reports, daily checklist)
Create business requirements for the onboarding of new datasets and collaborate with software developers to test and implement data processing/storage
Explore artificial intelligence tools to enhance existing reference data operations, data quality controls, and production monitoring processes
Participate in the team’s evolution from manually maintaining data to maintaining and monitoring data definitions, quality service-level expectations, exception thresholds, and downstream consumption patterns
Partner with data engineering and business stakeholders to modernize static data quality rules, such as null checks, format checks, and cross-field validations, by introducing contextual quality validation that can learn from historical data, market behavior, and cross-dataset relationships


Required Skills


10+ years of relevant investment industry experience, working with reference or research data
Strong expertise in portfolio/security master data structures and lifecycle events
Hands-on experience with NeoXam DataHub (mandatory)
Strong data analysis skills using python and SQL; ability to work with large datasets
Proven experience supporting or leading security master platform conversions/migrations
Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence tools and a demonstrated interest in applying them to evolving business needs
High energy and positive attitude – candidate should be conscientious, self-directed, and possess a strong work ethic
Flexibility to be on call to log in at night as needed on a rotational basis
Intellectual curiosity about investment data
Attention to detail with a focus on data quality and control
Strong analytical, organizational, project management, and written communication skills.
Familiarity with BlackRock Aladdin
Familiarity with financial market data providers (Bloomberg, LSEG, ICE)


$155,000 - $170,000 a year

This salary range is estimated for this role and actual pay may be different based on a candidate’s qualifications and/or years of experience. In addition, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus award, which award may be determined by individual, team, department and firm performance, and is subject to the terms of GMO’s compensation plan. This position is also benefits eligible. GMO’s comprehensive benefits program includes medical insurance, dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability coverage, a 401(k)/profit-sharing retirement plan, open paid time off, leaves of absences, dependent care resources, tuition reimbursement, charitable gifts matching, flexible spending accounts, and commuter benefits.

GMO is committed to the recruitment, employment, and promotion of all candidates equally, regardless of an individual's gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, age, religion, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability (except where such disability is a bona fide occupational disqualification) or any other classification protected under federal, state or local law.

GMO will not offer visa sponsorship for this opportunity.

Title: Technical Data Analyst
Description:
Position: Technical Data Analyst

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Duration: Multi Year Renewable Contract

Hours: 37.5 Hours per week

Rate: $60-65/hr W2

Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Technical Data Analyst to support enterprise data quality, migration, and integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have experience assessing, profiling, cleansing, validating, and transforming large datasets while developing reporting and integration solutions to support business and technical teams.

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data management within enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality principles, and data lifecycle management.


Technical Skills


Experience performing data profiling to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and validity of enterprise data.
Proven ability to execute data cleansing, standardization, deduplication, and validation activities using established data quality methodologies.
Experience developing and maintaining data mapping documents, data conversion templates, validation templates, reconciliation reports, and data quality scorecards.
Proficiency in writing SQL and scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to automate data cleansing, transformation, validation, and reconciliation processes.
Experience creating automated validation routines to compare source and target datasets and identify data quality issues.
Strong knowledge of relational databases and data modeling concepts.


Reporting & Analytics


Experience developing interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Microsoft Power BI.
Ability to analyze data quality metrics and communicate findings through executive dashboards and technical reports.
Experience creating KPIs and visualizations to monitor data quality, migration progress, and operational performance.


Integration & APIs


Experience working with MuleSoft for API-led integrations and enterprise data exchange.
Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, XML, and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience supporting API testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with integrating cloud applications, including CRM platforms such as Salesforce, using APIs.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Salesforce CRM implementations, migrations, or data quality initiatives.
Experience with ETL/data integration tools and enterprise data migration projects.
Familiarity with data quality platforms such as Cloudingo, DemandTools, Informatica, Talend, or similar solutions.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
Knowledge of healthcare, provider, payer, or regulated industry data is preferred.


Key Responsibilities


Perform data profiling and quality assessments to identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplicates, and validation issues.
Design and execute data cleansing and transformation activities to improve data quality.
Develop scripts and automated processes for data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and exception reporting.
Create and maintain data mapping documents, conversion templates, and validation artifacts.
Build Tableau and Power BI dashboards to monitor data quality, migration readiness, and business metrics.
Support API integrations and data exchange using MuleSoft and REST APIs.
