Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Robotics
Description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Business Intelligence Engineer to join the BI Engineering, Analytics, & Data Science (BAND) team supporting Robotic Storage Tech (RST) programs within Amazon Robotics. In this role, you will bring a strong foundation in statistics to support the introduction of new containerized and workcell robotic products — from early concept through deployment. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous questions about new product performance into structured analyses, and author recommendation-focused deliverables that inform program decisions and shape how new robotic systems progress through RST's development lifecycle. You will design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and other analytics artifacts purpose-built for new product introduction — tracking system maturity, surfacing readiness gaps, and enabling data-driven milestone decisions. You are a collaborative problem-solver who thinks holistically about how new systems evolve from prototype to production and uses data to accelerate that journey.

Key job responsibilities


Statistical Analysis for New Products: Execute foundational statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, design of experiments, and regression analysis to evaluate new containerized and workcell system performance against readiness criteria at each development phase.
Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Program Managers, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous new product questions into structured analyses that support milestone decisions.
Data Source Development: Identify and onboard data sources from new containerized and workcell systems as they come online, define NPI-relevant metrics, and build data pipelines that enable performance tracking.
Whitepaper & Insights Delivery: Author recommendation-focused whitepapers and deep-dive analyses that inform new product development decisions — including system configuration trade-offs, readiness assessments, and deployment strategy recommendations.
BI Ownership: Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that track new containerized and workcell products through their Alpha, Beta, and General Availability phases, providing visibility into system maturation and operational readiness.


A day in the life

On any given day, you might be helping run a designed experiment to evaluate a configuration change on a new workcell system, building a readiness dashboard for a containerized product approaching its Beta milestone, or authoring a whitepaper that supports a recommendation whether a new system is ready to advance to the next development phase. You will own major components of the BAND team's NPI analytics infrastructure for RST, including contributing to data architecture decisions and delivering reports that track new products from through General Availability.

You will maintain a deep understanding of data lineage across your BI solutions — from the telemetry and event streams generated by new containerized and workcell systems, through metric aggregation processes, to how insights are consumed at milestone reviews and program readiness gates. You will create and optimize scripts (SQL, Python, R, Shell) to streamline BI processes and select appropriate analytics and visualization tools to meet diverse new product evaluation needs.

Your work will directly influence how new containerized and workcell products move through RST's development pipeline and shape the future of Amazon's robotic storage technology landscape.

About The Team

Robotic Storage Tech (RST) invents, designs, and develops transformational storage solutions used in the Amazon Logistic Network. We will realize the next generation of automated containerized systems, and optimize our existing install base. We are a team of talented engineers, product evangelists, and creators focused on technologies that make inventory pick, stow, and count safer and more efficient for Amazon. We deliver value with our elite robotic technologies because we listen and respond to our many customers, develop robust and reliable solutions, and invest in both our people and our products.

Basic Qualifications


3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience writing complex SQL queries
Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

You are a collaborative problem-solver who thinks holistically about how new systems evolve from prototype to production and uses data to accelerate that journey.

Key job responsibilities

  • Statistical Analysis for New Products: Execute foundational statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, design of experiments, and regression analysis to evaluate new containerized and workcell system performance against readiness criteria at each development phase.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Program Managers, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous new product questions into structured analyses that support milestone decisions.
  • Data Source Development: Identify and onboard data sources from new containerized and workcell systems as they come online, define NPI-relevant metrics, and build data pipelines that enable performance tracking.
  • Whitepaper & Insights Delivery: Author recommendation-focused whitepapers and deep-dive analyses that inform new product development decisions — including system configuration trade-offs, readiness assessments, and deployment strategy recommendations.

You will create and optimize scripts (SQL, Python, R, Shell) to streamline BI processes and select appropriate analytics and visualization tools to meet diverse new product evaluation needs.

Title: Customer Experience Analyst
Description:
About SimpliSafe

We're a high-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

About The Job

The SimpliSafe CX Analytics team is looking for a Senior Analyst to co-own performance for our rapidly growing Telesales and Loyalty channels — both key strategic priorities for SimpliSafe's future growth. In this role, you won't just measure a team of 150+ agents driving new customer acquisition and subscriber retention — you will help set the strategy that determines whether they succeed.

This is a unique opportunity to build deep, sustained fluency in how Telesales and Loyalty actually operate — and to use that fluency to identify what the business should be doing differently, not just report on what it did. You will define the KPIs that matter, understand what truly drives them, forecast where they're headed, and then support experiments aimed at identifying the right tactics to beat that forecast. You will share accountability for the outcome with Operational leadership, not just for the accuracy of the analysis. Your responsibilities will include:


Own the full KPI lifecycle for Telesales and Loyalty performance: define the right KPIs at the channel and agent level, build and maintain the forecasts for them, and develop a deep understanding of what drives them
Originate and lead experimentation aimed at beating those forecasts — partnering with the business to identify test ideas and ensuring rigorous setup and measurement so the business can trust the read
Get close enough to the operation — the agents, the workflows, the day-to-day realities of Telesales and Loyalty — to spot risks and opportunities Operations can't see from the inside, and bring recommendations to leadership before they ask
Share accountability with Operational leadership for the business results, not just the integrity of the analysis — success is measured by whether Telesales and Loyalty performance improves, not just whether the reporting is right
Serve as data steward for the datasets underlying these KPIs, and use AI tools and automation to eliminate as much manual reporting and one-off analysis as possible — reinvesting that time into the work above


Qualifications:


BS in a quantitative field or equivalent experience (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field)
5+ years of equivalent experience, or Masters + 3 years
Strong technical skills, including experience with query and data visualization tools. SQL and Excel are core requirements; experience with Tableau, Hex, or programming languages (Python, R, etc.) is a plus
Track record of proposing ideas and driving them to business impact, not just delivering requested analysis — comfortable being judged on whether the business outcome moved, not only on whether the work was correct
Experience designing and running experiments or pilots — including forming the hypothesis, not just measuring someone else's
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with extreme attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize concepts for non-technical audiences and effectively engage partners across all levels of the company
Genuine interest in learning how a complex operation runs day-to-day — willing to spend real time with Ops and agents, not just their data — in order to identify the question behind the question
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate data prep and analysis, so more time goes toward business understanding and origination
Experience supporting contact center operations is a plus


What Values You'll Share


Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
No Ego - Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.


What We Offer


A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.


The target annual base pay range for this role is $65,000 to $87,500

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

Title: Supply Chain Business Systems Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 2015 to develop the world’s first industrially scalable laser metal additive manufacturing solution, VulcanForms is reshaping how the world manufactures critical products. We build and operate advanced digital infrastructure that enables innovation, accelerates growth, and supports sustainability across aerospace, defense, medical, and other essential industries. Through our vertically integrated capabilities, including scalable additive manufacturing and precision machining, we deliver true end-to-end production at scale by combining cutting-edge technology with a foundation of proven industrial craftsmanship. Our team brings deep expertise in manufacturing, materials science, software, automation, and operations, united by a shared commitment to quality, curiosity, and accountability. We foster an inclusive culture where people take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously learn, because we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes.

Job Purpose

The Business Systems Analyst, Supply Chain is responsible for improving the efficiency, structure, and analytical capability of VulcanForms’ supply chain organization by enabling effective use of business systems, data, and reporting tools. This role focuses on organizing information, improving visibility into procurement activity, and building reliable analytical views that support planning, sourcing, and execution across the supply chain. This is a hands-on role that works closely with supply chain, procurement, finance, and information technology teams to improve workflows, data access, and reporting across supply chain systems and collaboration platforms.

Key Responsibilities


Support and continuously improve supply chain business systems used for procurement, supplier management, contract management, sourcing events, and internal collaboration
Design, build, and maintain analytical reports and dashboards that provide visibility into procurement activity, supplier spend, and supply chain performance.
Extract, organize, and analyze data from enterprise business systems to support reporting, forecasting, and decision-making.
Develop and maintain structured views of supplier and spend data, including category-level and supplier-level analysis.
Improve data quality, consistency, and usability across supply chain tools and reporting outputs
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, standardize workflows, and improve information flow across the supply chain organization
Manage and organize supply chain collaboration sites, shared documentation, and reporting workspaces to improve accessibility and alignment
Document system workflows, reporting logic, and data definitions to support scalability, continuity, and disciplined execution.


Qualifications


3+ of experience in a business systems analyst, supply chain analytics, procurement operations, or similar role.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain, information systems, engineering, or a related field
Demonstrated experience working with procurement or supply chain data within enterprise business systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, analyze, and interpret complex datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis and reporting.
Experience building reports, dashboards, or analytical summaries for operational, sourcing, or leadership audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and explain analytical findings clearly.


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, and Microsoft-based collaboration or reporting tools used to organize, analyze, and present supply chain data.
Proficiency with business intelligence and data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau, including dashboard design and data modeling.
Experience extracting and shaping data from enterprise resource planning systems, preferably Epicor or similar manufacturing-focused platforms.
Demonstrated experience building spend analysis, supplier performance reporting, or category-level analytics for procurement or supply chain teams.
Familiarity with data integration methods, reporting automation, or application programming interfaces used to improve data access and visibility.


VulcanForms offers a competitive salary and equity package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, VulcanForms provides comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; generous paid time off; and a 401(k) plan with company match.

The annual base salary range for this position is $67,000 to $93,000.

Title: Alpha Account Services Data Analyst, Officer
Description:
Who We Are Looking For

The Alpha Strategy and Implementation Services Team at State Street is seeking a qualified Account Services Data Analyst to support client account onboarding, maintenance, and configuration activities across the Alpha Platform. This role is focused on collecting and validating client account reference data, supporting system configuration, and applying data controls that help enable accurate, timely, and consistent account setup across front-, middle-, and back-office services.

Key Responsibilities


Support the collection, review, and organization of client account data required for new account launches, lifecycle events, and static data maintenance.
Assist with account data validation, enrichment, and control activities to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and required client or internal follow-up om the Account Matrix/Conversion Data.
Support system configuration activities across Account Services workflow tools and downstream Alpha applications based on approved client account data.
Partner with clients, implementation leads, data leads, product, technology, and downstream operations teams to resolve data issues and support readiness for testing, conversion, and production use.



Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen, implementation teams are needed to help clients navigate employees and the organization as a whole during their initial onboarding. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As an Alpha Account Services Data Analyst, Officer you will


Collect, organize, and analyze client account data required to support client conversions.
Review client-provided data for completeness, consistency, and alignment to Account Services data requirements, templates, and agreed operating models.
Maintain and update client account data artifacts account setup data dictionaries, configuration trackers, validation logs, and related implementation documentation.
Support configuration of account attributes, dropdown values, lookups, business rules, checklist items, and other client-specific settings within Account Services workflow and administration tools.
Perform data profiling, reconciliation, and validation exercises to confirm that account data is accurately reflected across Account Services tools and downstream Alpha systems.
Investigate data exceptions, configuration breaks, and validation failures; document root cause, proposed resolution, ownership, and status through closure.
Partner with implementation leads, project managers, product owners, technology teams, and downstream service teams to clarify data requirements and resolve configuration dependencies.
Support testing cycles by preparing test data, reviewing expected results, validating configuration outcomes, and documenting defects or required remediation.
Apply data controls to ensure accurate, complete, and timely account setup, maintenance, and conversion activity.
Document field-level definitions, population rules, required values, impacted workstreams, and downstream usage to support consistent data interpretation.
Monitor configuration readiness, data quality issues, and open action items; escalate blockers that may impact testing, conversion, or production timelines.
Support post-go-live remediation and change activity by analyzing data impacts, validating updates, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders.
Contribute to reusable standards, templates, control checks, and best practices that improve the consistency and scalability of Account Services implementations.



What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role


Strong analytical skills with the ability to review large sets of data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
Experience supporting data collection, data validation, system configuration, testing, and operational readiness within financial services or investment operations.
Working knowledge of Python, SQL, Excel, data profiling, reconciliation techniques, and reporting tools used to support data analysis and control activities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate data issues into clear actions for clients, implementation teams, technology partners, and operations stakeholders.



Education & Preferred Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, MIS, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field of study
5+ years of experience in data analysis, investment operations, client implementation, account services, or financial services technology
Experience with account onboarding, system configuration, data controls, or implementation testing preferred



Salary Range

$70,000 - $118,750 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Title: Founding Data Analyst
Description:
About Counsel

Counsel’s mission is to multiply the world's healthcare capacity. We believe in a future in which every person has a personalized, AI-enabled doctor always in their pocket. To accomplish this, we’re building the first fully-vertical, AI-native medical group from the ground up. We’ve redesigned the entire clinical stack with custom AI tools that make our in-house physicians 10x faster and smarter. [learn more on our blog]

Since our founding in 2023, we have formed partnerships with leading healthcare organizations and are on track to serve hundreds of thousands of patients on our platform within the next year. We have raised over $35M from a16z, Google Ventures, Pear VC and other top-tier VC firms.

Our team combines deep expertise in medicine (Harvard, Mt. Sinai, Mass General, UCSF) and technology (MIT, Google, DeepMind, NVIDIA, Stripe, Meta) — and we’re looking for exceptional people to join us as we scale.

Join us as we build the future of AI in healthcare!

About The Role

We're hiring a Founding Data Analyst to join our FinOps team and build the data foundation that powers Counsel's growth. This is an early-stage, high-impact founding role spanning data wrangling and pipeline development, defining and tracking core operating metrics, and improving reporting and operational workflows across the business.

You'll work directly with our SVP, Finance & Operations and collaborate across Commercial/GTM, Finance, Clinical Ops, and Operations. Instead of owning a small slice of the business, you'll gain broad exposure and take on increasing responsibility as you help build and improve the systems that keep the company running and scaling. This role will have executive level cross functional partnership and requires the ability to connect dots across stakeholders in various organizations.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain the data foundation that will power the entire company.
Support the data needs of stakeholders across every function at the company. This will range from product metrics, commercial / client reporting, internal financial and operating metrics.
Build the Operating Scorecard and management dashboards so the entire team can have visibility on business performance and one source of truth.
Partner with Analytics Engineer to validate pipelines and metric definitions.
Turn messy datasets into answers people can act on.
Build and adopt AI-powered tools and workflows that make FinOps faster and efficient.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (CS, statistics, applied math, or similar), with meaningful programming experience
3-5 years in a data, analytics, or finance/ops role
Strong SQL, and Python or a similar language to be dangerous
Comfort with data that's messy and real, the kind you dig into instead of flagging as someone else's problem. An inherent desire to be a truth seeker
Executive presence to represent senior leaders in cross functional discussions
Genuinely curious about AI tools, and quick to find ways they can cut manual work out of your own workflow


Bonus points for


Experience with dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, or BigQuery
Experience in healthcare or healthtech
A track record of ramping quickly into new tools, since many of ours are still being built


What We Offer


Impact: Be at the forefront and contribute to groundbreaking, AI-driven healthcare experiences, directly interface with execs at the world's leading tech & healthcare orgs
Growth: Significant opportunities for broad ownership and professional development within our rapidly scaling startup
Compensation: Competitive salary + equity
Benefits: Comprehensive healthcare, vision + dental, 401K, Unlimited PTO, Parental Leave


Our Values


Patients come first. We are clinicians 1st, technologists 2nd. We act with patient trust/safety at the center of every decision.
Innovate with optimism. We are optimistic as we build the future of care delivery from first principles. Challenge the status quo when needed, no sacred cows.
Right answer wins. Debate openly and pick the strongest path. We optimize for the company, not functions. We win and lose as a team.
Simplicity over complexity. We choose clear, elegant solutions and avoid adding complexity that does not serve patients or the team.
Do fewer things, well. We focus, and hold ourselves to the highest bar and pursue excellence in those areas.

Join us as we build the future of AI in healthcare!

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (CS, statistics, applied math, or similar), with meaningful programming experience
  • 3-5 years in a data, analytics, or finance/ops role
  • Strong SQL, and Python or a similar language to be dangerous
  • Comfort with data that's messy and real, the kind you dig into instead of flagging as someone else's problem. An inherent desire to be a truth seeker
  • Executive presence to represent senior leaders in cross functional discussions
  • Genuinely curious about AI tools, and quick to find ways they can cut manual work out of your own workflow

Bonus points for

  • Experience in healthcare or healthtech
  • A track record of ramping quickly into new tools, since many of ours are still being built

  • Impact: Be at the forefront and contribute to groundbreaking, AI-driven healthcare experiences, directly interface with execs at the world's leading tech & healthcare orgs
  • Growth: Significant opportunities for broad ownership and professional development within our rapidly scaling startup
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + equity
  • Benefits: Comprehensive healthcare, vision + dental, 401K, Unlimited PTO, Parental Leave

  • Patients come first. We are clinicians 1st, technologists 2nd. We act with patient trust/safety at the center of every decision.
  • Innovate with optimism. We are optimistic as we build the future of care delivery from first principles. Challenge the status quo when needed, no sacred cows.

Title: Reliability Analytics Engineer, Amazon Robotics
Description:
Description

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? We apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world problems that delight our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. Amazon Robotics is at the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse team of engineers come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots and mechatronic systems. We design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in self-governing movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

We are seeking a Reliability Engineer specializing in reliability data analytics to drive data-informed availability selections across Amazon Robotics product programs and deployed fleet. You will apply reliability engineering methods while owning the assessment tools, datasets, and reporting that the broader reliability engineering team depends on. You will define requirements for data pipelines and dashboards, use AI and automation to build them, and directly develop reliability-specific assessment tools. This role combines hands-on reliability engineering with a strong bias toward data systems, enabling the team to scale its evaluation capacity across multiple product programs simultaneously.

Key job responsibilities

Define data requirements and specifications for reliability pipelines; partner with data engineering teams to build and validate ETL processes that ingest field failures, test data, and product telemetry from enterprise data lakes and EAM systems.

Perform data cleansing, validation, and preparation of reliability datasets (censored life data, field service records, accelerated test results) to ensure assessment correctness before use in making engineering choices.

Translate reliability engineering questions into data queries and assessment workflows structuring ambiguous problems into repeatable, scalable evaluation methods that other engineers can reuse.

Develop and maintain reliability-specific assessment tools and automation using Python, AI/ML, and statistical libraries (e.g., automated failure mode classification, survival assessment calculators, and fleet health monitoring scripts)

Design and specify dashboard requirements for reliability KPIs (availability, MTBF, MTTR, failure rate trends); build prototypes and operationalize production dashboards.

Identify gaps in available data, define collection requirements for new failure modes or test programs, and work with hardware test and field teams to close data gaps.

Establish data governance practices for reliability datasets (i.e. metadata standards, version control, traceability to source systems) so assessment findings are reproducible and auditable.

A day in the life

You run Mean Cumulative Function (MCF) and Weibull examinations on robot fleets, ensuring suspensions are correct before publishing to the reliability team. You meet with data engineers to define telemetry pipeline requirements: necessary fields, censoring rules, and output schemas. You build Python tools that automate reliability growth tracking pulling from the data lake, applying models, and generating standard reports any engineer can run. You deliver failure rate data by subsystem for DFMEA exercises. You refine Machine Learning classifiers that auto-tag field failure tickets by mode, improving accuracy from sustaining team feedback. You're a reliability engineer who understands repairable systems, physics-of-failure, and life data. Your differentiator is scaling expertise through data tools, automation, and AI—building systems the entire team can run.

Amazon Robotics Reliability Engineering is a team of experts in diverse engineering disciplines joined by a passion to astonish customers through solving complex optimization problems. We succeed by embracing ambiguity, moving at a fast pace, and supporting each other's growth.

BS degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
3+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
Experience applying basic statistical methods (e.g. regression) to difficult business problems

Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms
Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, EMR and RDS
Experience managing and deploying ML products

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.

Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.

Description:

Job Summary

Responsible for gathering disparate data files from various sources. Analyze and normalize to ensure quality and process for upload into the master data management or other related software. Provide guidance and analysis on processed data that empower Purchasing, Sales, Sourcing, and Pricing teams to attain objectives.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities


Inputs and analyzes data received from external sources to ensure accurate and validated data is available for associates in decision making and customer service.
Serves as individual contributor on a data team that could include responsibility for, but not limited to: product file maintenance; cost matrix maintenance; price matrix maintenance; employee and organizational hierarchy; vendor file maintenance; and /or customer file maintenance.
Assesses work processes to identify opportunities to automate, minimize error and maximize productivity. Develops tools to monitor for compliance to standards.
Works with the team to determine root cause for discrepancies, correct processes and implement change.


Nature and Scope


Demonstrates skill in data analysis techniques by resolving missing/incomplete information and inconsistencies/anomalies in more complex research/data.
Nature of work requires increasing independence; receives guidance only on unusual, complex problems or issues. Work review typically involves periodic review of output by a supervisor and/or direct customers of the process.
May provide general guidance/direction to or train junior level support or professional personnel.


Work Environment


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
No travel required.


Education And Experience


Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally 2-5 years of experience in a related field OR MS/MA and generally 2-4 years of experience in a related field. Certification is required in some areas.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

Pension and Retirement Plans

Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Position Type

Permanent

Closing Date

2026-08-06

Medavie Health Services is a national leader in primary health care solutions and the largest contracted provider of emergency management services in Canada. Together with Medavie Blue Cross, we are part of Medavie, a health solutions partner committed to improving the wellbeing of Canadians.

With a growing network of 5,400 health care professionals in six provinces, Medavie Health Services has a long history of operating ground and air ambulance services, medical communications, Mobile Integrated Health/Community Paramedicine programs, 911 Public Safety, 811 Telehealth, home health care, as well as clinical training.

We are proud to invest in communities to help address some of Canada’s most pressing physical and mental health care challenges.

As an employee of Medavie Health Services, we are accountable to our patients and coworkers by participating in and supporting all safety related initiatives, as well as acting in a manner that fosters a culture that focuses on patient safety and a safe and respectful workplace.

Island EMS, a subsidiary of Medavie Health Services (MHS), began operating the ground ambulance service in Prince Edward Island in April 2006 and is responsible for the optimal operation and management of an integrated, service-led primary health care organization including Medacom Atlantic and the PEI Mobile Mental Health Program. People are the biggest drivers of our success, and we are excited to continue building a healthier Prince Edward Island together.

In this role, the Senior Data Analyst is responsible for providing contract reporting, strategic analysis and supporting key processes within Island EMS. The Senior data analyst will report to the Regional Director, Prince Edward Island Operations and will work closely with many areas of the organization, including the Island EMS leadership team, to understand their monitoring, reporting and data needs.

The incumbent will assume responsibility for the production, maintenance and support of a suite of dashboards and reports for the entire organization. They will be a subject matter expert on source system data and will accurately extract and analyze data to meet the various demands of the business. The incumbent will be a key member of a team of professionals who support the ongoing development of Key Performance indicators and monitoring and reporting of EMS system performance.

The position entails, but is not limited to the following:


Development and maintenance of dashboards as specified by the business areas.
Work closely with the other members of the team to ensure reporting standards are maintained and overall information governance is adhered to.
Act as a key advisor to the senior management team on operational and strategic data analysis
Provide data for scheduled and unscheduled reporting on contractually identified KPIs and performance measures, including reviewing all component reports for accuracy and completeness;
Prioritize incoming requests, manage expectations and working relationships.
Data mining, analysis and interpretation of data, reports and trends in EMS;
Support the ongoing development of reporting tools to reflect evolving business requirement;
Support business development through analysis of data and modelling of system impacts;
Developing evidence informed auditing tools and processes for new and existing programs, services and initiatives;
Ensure that privacy is respected in measurement and reporting systems;
Build and maintain productive working relationship with our business partners;
Other duties as assigned.


As The Ideal Candidate For This Role, You


Have a university degree, preferably a Master's degree, in Health System Performance, Health Services Research, Applied Statistics, Data Science, Systems Engineering, Health Informatics, Public Health, Epidemiology, or a related discipline; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Minimum 5 years' experience in health system analytics, performance measurement, quality improvement, decision support, or strategic planning.
Demonstrated experience developing performance frameworks, outcome measures, dashboards, and executive reporting.
Experience with data visualization technologies and business intelligence platforms.
Experience applying data to support continuous quality improvement, patient safety, accreditation, and organizational strategy.
Previous work experience or knowledge of emergency medical services is an asset
Ability to analyze, understand and interpret business requirements
Understand data-visualization concepts
Strong understanding of business drivers and KPIs (key performance indicators)
Excellent analytical, research and problem-solving skills;
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate clearly
Have comprehensive knowledge of technical database management and reporting management functions;
Have knowledge and understanding of the key records management and information management standards and legislation and information standards;


Regular business hours required, but some irregular hours can be expected.

Salary range for this position is $75,000 - $90,000 annually.

The Base Pay range may vary depending on the successful candidate or other relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and education/training. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Medavie employees may participate in various performance-based incentive programs. Payments under these programs are discretionary and subject to both individual and organizational results.

While Medavie may use automated tools, including AI, to support application screening, candidates are expected to complete all recruitment interactions independently—without AI assistance—to ensure a fair and equitable process.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Medavie Health Services is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

Title: Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Key Responsibilities

Offer Execution & Optimization


Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
Fare price optimization
Ancillary price optimization
Dynamic bundle generation
Offer optimization and decisioning
Commercial experimentation and testing
Offer governance and configuration
Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.


Cross-Functional Delivery


Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations


Performance Management


Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
Revenue uplift
Conversion rates
Ancillary attachment
Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
2–4 years of experience in data analytics, airline commercial strategy, pricing, revenue management, product management, or distribution
Experience supporting complex technology or commercial transformation initiatives
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors
Understanding of airline pricing and revenue management principles
Familiarity with Offer Management and Pricing Optimization concepts
Knowledge of airline retailing and distribution
Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing performance data
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights
Strong hands-on experience querying large relational databases using SQL on cloud platforms like Snowflake, and visualizing data in tools like Tableau or PowerBI
Familiarity with API testing and validation (e.g., using Postman) to support technical troubleshooting and vendor integrations is an asset


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isn’t the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

We are currently seeking a Data Innovation & Development Specialist to support the mine and mill’s operational data and reporting ecosystem—maintaining reliable datasets and dashboards (PI Vision, Power BI) and deliver practical analytics and automation within site governance. This role focuses on data and reporting software (not PI tag/asset configuration).

This role is based at the Côté Gold Mine Site reporting to the IT OT Superintendent.

Sustain mill reporting data layers and dashboards to deliver trusted, timely operational insights.

Key Skills & Knowledge


Post-secondary degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).

At least 3 years of experience in a similar role.
Experience supporting operational data systems in an industrial environment (e.g., processing plant/mill), including reporting databases, historian data access, and front-end dashboards/reports (PI Vision, Power BI, or similar).
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts (e.g., query optimization, views, stored procedures) and experience delivering reliable datasets and semantic models for analytics and reporting.

Strong data analysis and troubleshooting capability, including validating, reconciling, and clearly explaining operational KPIs and data flows from OT systems through to reporting.
